works.title: 寄左省杜拾遗
works.author: 岑参
works.note: 【寄左省杜拾遗】唐代岑参所作的诗。
works.tr: 聯步趨丹陛，分曹限紫微。曉隨天仗入，暮惹御香歸。白髮悲花落，青雲羨鳥飛。聖朝無闕事，自覺諫書稀。

【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

Assigned to different bureaus, divided by the Purple Pavilion wall.
At dawn we enter with the imperial retinue in file,
At dusk we return, our robes scented by the imperial censer's call.
With white hairs I grieve as spring flowers fall,
Gazing at blue clouds I envy birds their free flight overall.
In this sagely court there are no faults to be corrected,
I feel that my remonstrance memorials grow fewer, and small.

works.title: 白雪歌送武判官归京
works.author: 岑参
works.note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【白雪歌送武判官归京】唐代岑参所作的诗。
works.tr: 北風捲地白草折，胡天八月即飛雪。忽然一夜春風來，千樹萬樹梨花開。散入珠簾濕羅幕，狐裘不煖錦衾薄。將軍角弓不得控，都護鐵衣冷難着。瀚海闌干百丈冰，愁雲黲淡萬里凝。中軍置酒飲歸客，胡琴琵琶與羌笛。紛紛暮雪下轅門，風掣紅旗凍不翻。輪臺東門送君去，去時雪滿天山路。山迴路轉不見君，雪上空留馬行處。
works.appr: 《白雪歌送武判官归京》是唐代岑参所作的诗名篇。全诗共18句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《白雪歌送武判官归京》历代传诵不衰，是岑参诗歌风格的集中体现。
works.st:
【起·开篇】前4句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第5至9句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第10至13句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末5句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。
works.img:
【月】月亮意象，常寄托思乡、怀人、孤寂之意，亦象征高洁、永恒。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【花】花意象，喻美好青春，落花则有伤春、惜逝之意。

【草】草意象，春草生意，秋草萧瑟，常喻离愁与岁月。

【酒】酒意象，送别饯行、遣怀消愁、畅叙友情皆用之。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。

works.theme: 《白雪歌送武判官归京》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代岑参的代表性作品之一。
en_body: North winds sweep the earth, snapping white grass blades,
In the borderlands, already in the eighth month snow fills the skies.
Suddenly it is as if a spring breeze came overnight,
And thousands of pear trees bloomed before our eyes.
Snowflakes drift through pearl curtains, dampening silk screens,
Fox fur robes bring no warmth, brocade quilts feel thin likewise.
The general's horn bow is too frozen to draw,
The protector's iron armor is too cold to wear, to our surprise.
Across the vast desert ice stretches a hundred fathoms deep,
Sorrow-laden clouds hang frozen for ten thousand miles, no cries.
In the central camp wine is set to see the traveler home,
Hu lutes, pipas, and Qiang flutes play their melodies, sighs.
At dusk heavy snow falls thick outside the camp gate,
In the biting wind the red flag is frozen, it cannot rise.
At Luntai's eastern gate I see you off on your way,
As you leave, snow covers the roads to the Heavenly Mountains' size.
The road twists, the mountains turn, and you are lost from sight,
Only hoof prints remain in the snow, marking where you said goodbyes.

狐裘穿不暖锦被也嫌太薄。

works.title: 走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征
works.author: 岑参
body: 君不见走马川行雪海边，
works.note: 【走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征】唐代岑参所作的诗。
works.tr: 君不見走馬川行雪海邊，平沙莽莽黃入天。輪臺九月風夜吼，一川碎石大如斗，隨風滿地石亂走。匈奴草黃馬正肥，金山西見煙塵飛。漢家大將西出師，將軍金甲夜不脫。半夜軍行戈相撥，風頭如刀面如割。馬毛帶雪汗氣蒸，五花連錢旋作冰。幕中草檄硯水凝，虜騎聞之應膽懾。料知短兵不敢接，車師西門佇獻捷。
works.appr: 《走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征》是唐代岑参所作的诗名篇。全诗共15句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征》历代传诵不衰，是岑参诗歌风格的集中体现。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【水】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【花】花意象，喻美好青春，落花则有伤春、惜逝之意。

【草】草意象，春草生意，秋草萧瑟，常喻离愁与岁月。

works.theme: 《走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征》主旨在于描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代岑参的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Have you not seen Zouma River, by the Sea of Snow?
Where vast yellow sands stretch upward to the sky.
In Luntai in the ninth month, fierce winds roar at night,
Stones in the river bed are as large as pecks, oh my!
They roll and tumble everywhere across the ground,
Driven by the howling gale that passes by.
The Xiongnu grass is yellow, their horses fat and strong,
West of the Golden Mountains dust and smoke rise high.
The great general of Han leads his army west on campaign,
At night the general never takes off his golden armor, nigh.
They march at midnight, spears and halberds clashing,
Wind cuts like a knife, slicing faces as they sigh.
Snow on horsehair mingles with steaming sweat, on dappled coats it freezes into ice in the blink of an eye.
In the tent they draft dispatches, inkstone water frozen,
When the enemy hears this, their courage should die.
I know they will not dare to meet us in close combat,
We shall wait at the west gate of Jushi for victory to draw nigh.

works.en_title: 走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征
baihua_lines: 你难道没有看见走马川就在雪海旁边，
茫茫黄沙一直连接到天边。
轮台九月里狂风在夜间怒吼，
匈奴牧草黄壮战马正是肥美的时候，
金山以西已经看到烟尘飞扬。
汉朝的大将率兵向西出征，
将军夜里都不脱下金甲。
半夜行军戈矛互相碰撞，
风头如刀刮在脸上如同切割。
马毛上挂着雪汗气蒸腾，
五花连钱斑纹的马身上转眼就结成冰。
军帐中起草檄文砚水都冻结了，
敌人听到这些应该会胆战心惊。
料想他们不敢短兵相接前来迎战，
我们在车师西门等待献上捷报。

en_body: Above Luntai's walls the horn sounds through the night,
North of the city the Maotou star has fallen from the sky.
Urgent dispatches passed Quli last night, we hear,
The Chanyu's armies have come west of the Golden Mountains high.
From the watchtower westward dust darkens all the air,
Han troops have encamped north of Luntai, standing by.
The great general grasps the staff and marches west,
At dawn the flutes blow as the great army passes by.
War drums beat on four sides like a surging sea of snow,
The three armies' great shout shakes Yin Mountain, nigh.
War spirit at enemy camps rises up to the clouds,
White bones on the battlefield twist among grass roots, dry.
On Jian River wind blows fierce, snowflakes wide and thick,
At Shakou stones are frozen, horses' hooves slip and die.
Lord Imperial Secretary, you labor hard for the throne,
Vowing to repay your lord and pacify the border's cry.
Who has not seen names written in history since old times?
Today your deeds and fame shall all the ancients outvie.

baihua_lines: 轮台城头夜里吹起了号角，
轮台城北旄头星已经陨落。
紧急军书昨夜就过了渠黎，
单于的军队已经到了金山以西。
戍楼上向西望烟尘黑压压一片，
汉军已经屯驻在轮台以北。
大将手持旄节向西出征，
黎明时分吹起大军出发。
四面战鼓擂动如同雪海涌起，
三军大呼阴山都为之震动。
敌军营垒杀气直冲云霄，
战场上白骨缠绕着草根。
沙口石冻马蹄都能脱落。
御史大夫您为王室勤劳王事甘受苦辛，
发誓要报答君主平定边尘。
古来青史留名谁没有见过，
今日看您的功名胜过古人。

works.note: 【九日登望仙台呈刘明府】唐代崔曙所作的诗。
works.tr: 漢文皇帝有高臺，此日登臨曙色開。三晉雲山皆北向，二陵風雨自東來。關門令尹誰能識，河上仙翁去不回。且欲近尋彭澤宰，陶然共醉菊花杯。
works.appr: 《九日登望仙台呈刘明府》是唐代崔曙所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《九日登望仙台呈刘明府》历代传诵不衰，是崔曙诗歌风格的集中体现。

【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。
works.img:
【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【河】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【雨】雨意象，春雨喜，秋雨愁，夜雨乡思，暮雨离愁。

【花】花意象，喻美好青春，落花则有伤春、惜逝之意。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
works.bg: 《九日登望仙台呈刘明府》为唐代崔曙所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者崔曙在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
works.theme: 《九日登望仙台呈刘明府》主旨在于描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。；登临怀古，借古抒怀，寄寓历史兴亡之感。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代崔曙的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Emperor Wen of Han built this high terrace to gaze at immortals,
Today I climb it as the dawn light begins to spread.
Clouds and mountains of Sanjin all turn toward the north,
Wind and rain from the Two Tombs come rolling from east instead.
The gatekeeper at Hanguguan—who can recognize him now?
The immortal Old Man of the River is gone, never to tread.
I wish to seek you out nearby, like Tao of Pengze,
That we may drink together in joy, o'er chrysanthemum cups bread.

baihua_lines: 汉文帝在这里修筑了高高的望仙台，
今日我登临台上曙色刚刚散开。
三晋一带的云山都朝向北方，
二陵的风雨从东边滚滚而来。
函谷关的令尹谁人还能识得，
河上公这位仙翁一去不再回来。
我打算就近去寻访彭泽宰陶渊明那样的你，
一同开怀畅饮共醉菊花酒杯。

works.title: 孤雁
works.author: 崔涂
works.note: 【孤雁】唐代崔涂所作的诗。
works.tr: 葦岸風吹雨，沙汀月照霜。還同我兄弟，零落不成行。（見《能改齋漫錄》卷八。全詩八句，此爲後四句。
works.appr: 《孤雁》是唐代崔涂所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《孤雁》历代传诵不衰，是崔涂诗歌风格的集中体现。

【起·开篇】前1句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第2至3句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第4至5句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末2句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。

【霜】霜雪意象，既写冬景，也喻白发、苦寒、高洁。

Over sandbars the moon shines on frost white and cold.
You are just like us brothers, I think,
Scattered and lost, no longer flying in formation, bold.

works.title: 除夜有怀
works.author: 崔涂
works.note: 【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。；【除夜有怀】唐代崔涂所作的诗。

en_body: The bell and water clock at fifth watch seem to urge each other on,
The four seasons turn and change, cycling around again.
In the curtained bed the dying lamp's flame has just gone out,
Incense in the brazier has burned entirely to ash, no gain.
Gradually I feel spring draw near my lotus-embroidered pillow,
Suddenly the cold vanishes from the bamboo-leaf wine cup's reign.
Every family staying up to watch the year must still be awake,
In my longing, how can my dream-soul travel to your domain?

baihua_lines: 五更的钟鼓声仿佛在互相催促，
四时节气推移循环往复。
帐中残灯刚刚熄灭火焰，
炉中香气已经全都烧成灰烬。
渐渐感觉到春意逼近芙蓉绣枕，
顿时觉得寒意从竹叶酒杯中消散。
守岁的家家应该都还没有睡下，
相思之情中梦魂又怎能来到你身边。
works.baihua: 五更钟漏欲相催，四气推迁往复回。帐里残灯才去熖，炉中香气尽成灰。渐看春逼芙蓉枕，顿觉寒销竹叶杯。守岁家家应未卧，相思那得梦魂来。

The four seasons turn and change, cycling around again.
In the curtained bed the dying lamp's flame has just gone out,
Incense in the brazier has burned entirely to ash, no gain.

Suddenly the cold vanishes from the bamboo-leaf wine cup's reign.

In my longing, how can my dream-soul travel to your domain?

en_body: The lofty peaks of Mount Hua look down on Xianyang capital,
The three peaks piercing heaven were not cut by human hand.
Before Emperor Wu's shrine the clouds are about to scatter,
On the Immortal's Palm Peak the rain has just cleared, understand.
The River and Mountains pillow on Hangu Pass in the north, steep,
Post-road trees stretch west to Han altars flat across the land.
Let me ask you fame-and-profit seekers by the roadside,
Is it not better to learn eternal life here, on this strand?

works.author: 崔颢
works.note: 【黄鹤楼】唐代崔颢所作的诗。

en_body: Long ago the immortal rode away on a white crane,
Leaving nothing here but Yellow Crane Tower empty and bare.
Once the yellow crane departed, it never returned again,
For a thousand years white clouds drift idly in the air.
Across the sunlit river, trees of Hanyang stand out clear,
Spring grass grows thick and green on Parrot Islet fair.
At dusk where is my hometown? I cannot see it,
Mist and waves on the river fill my heart with care.

春草繁茂长满了鹦鹉洲。
日暮时分故乡在哪里呢？
江上烟波浩渺使人满怀忧愁。

At this hermitage only lonely clouds come and go.

To dwell with phoenixes and cranes the west mountains know.

隐居的地方只有孤云相伴。
松林梢头露出一弯微月，
清淡的月光依然照在你身上。
茅亭里花影仿佛在此安睡，
种药的院落长满了青苔纹。
我也想要辞去世俗隐居，
与西山的鸾鹤为伴为伍。

en_lines: The clear stream is deep, its bottom hard to measure,
At this hermitage only lonely clouds come and go.
A faint moon peeks through the edges of the pine trees,
Its clear light still shines on you, as if it knows.
In the thatched pavilion flower shadows seem to sleep,
The herb garden is overgrown with moss that grows.
I too would bid farewell to the world's affairs,
To dwell with phoenixes and cranes the west mountains know.

en_body: The sound of bugles cuts through the clear autumn,
Frontier soldiers lean against the watchtower wall.
Spring breeze blows over Wang Zhaojun's green tomb,
The white sun sets over Liangzhou, casting its pall.
Across the great desert no weapons block the way,
Travelers roam freely to the far borderlands, all.
The hearts of the Tibetan people are like this water,
Forever willing to flow south toward the Chinese hall.

en_lines: The sound of bugles cuts through the clear autumn,
Frontier soldiers lean against the watchtower wall.
Spring breeze blows over Wang Zhaojun's green tomb,
The white sun sets over Liangzhou, casting its pall.
Across the great desert no weapons block the way,
Travelers roam freely to the far borderlands, all.
The hearts of the Tibetan people are like this water,
Forever willing to flow south toward the Chinese hall.

works.title: 感遇·其一
works.author: 张九龄
works.note: 【感遇·其一】唐代张九龄所作的诗。
works.tr: 兰叶春葳蕤，桂华秋皎洁。欣欣此生意，自尔为佳节。谁知林栖者，闻风坐相悦。草木有本心，何求美人折！
works.appr: 《感遇·其一》是唐代张九龄所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《感遇·其一》历代传诵不衰，是张九龄诗歌风格的集中体现。
works.st:
【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

【草】草意象，春草生意，秋草萧瑟，常喻离愁与岁月。

works.bg: 《感遇·其一》为唐代张九龄所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者张九龄在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
works.theme: 《感遇·其一》主旨在于托物言志，借物抒怀，表达品格追求。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代张九龄的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Orchid leaves grow lush and abundant in spring,
Cassia blossoms shine bright and pure in autumn air.
They flourish, full of life and vibrant spirit,
Naturally making their seasons sweet and fair.
Who would have thought the hermits dwelling in the woods,
Catching their fragrance on the wind, would love them there?
Plants and trees have their own inborn nature true,
Why should they seek a beauty's hand to pluck them, where?

works.title: 感遇·其二
works.author: 张九龄
works.note: 【江南】长江以南地区，以水乡风光、温婉秀丽著称。；【感遇·其二】唐代张九龄所作的诗。
works.tr: 江南有丹橘，经冬犹绿林。岂伊地气暖，自有岁寒心。可以荐嘉客，奈何阻重深。运命唯所遇，循环不可寻。徒言树桃李，此木岂无阴？

baihua_lines: 历经整个冬天橘林依然苍翠。
难道是因为江南地气温暖的缘故吗？
其实是橘树自有耐寒坚贞的本心。
它的果实本可以用来款待贵客嘉宾，
无奈山重水阻隔，无法将它送往远方。
命运只能听凭遭遇的机缘，
周而复始的天理循环难以探寻。
世人只说要种桃树李树，
难道这橘树就不能为人遮出阴凉吗？

en_lines: Red tangerines grow in the lands south of the Yangtze,
Through winter their groves remain fresh and green.
Can it be that the southern clime alone keeps them warm?
Nay, they bear within themselves a heart that braves the frost.
These fruits might well be offered to noble guests,
Yet mountains and rivers bar the way, too deep to cross.
Fate is but what one chances to meet along the road,
Its wheeling course no mortal can fully trace.
Men speak only of planting peach and plum trees,
Does this orange tree afford no shade beneath its boughs?

works.title: 望月怀远
works.author: 张九龄
works.note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。；【天涯】天的尽头，指极远之地，常与漂泊、相思相连。；【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。

baihua_lines: 一轮皎洁的明月从辽阔的大海上升起，
远在天涯海角的人们此刻共同仰望着它。
多情的人抱怨这漫漫长夜太过悠长，
整夜里辗转难眠，心头涌起无尽的相思。
吹灭烛火，更怜爱这满室柔和的月光，
披上衣裳走出门，才发觉夜露已浸湿衣衫。
不能掬起一捧这美好的月光赠送给你，
还是回到床上吧，只盼能在梦中与你相会。
works.baihua: 海上生明月，天涯共此时。情人怨遥夜，竟夕起相思。灭烛怜光满，披衣觉露滋。不堪盈手赠，还寝梦佳期。
en_lines: Above the sea the bright moon rises,
Across the world's far ends we share this moment.
The lovelorn soul resents the dragging night,
All evening long, longings for you arise.
I blow the candle out, enamoured of the flooding light,
I wrap my robe about me, feeling the night dew damp.
I cannot scoop this moonbeams up to send to you,
So I turn back to bed, to dream of our sweet meeting.

works.author: 张旭
works.note: 【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。；【桃花溪】唐代张旭所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 一座长桥若隐若现，隔着郊野的烟雾横在空中，
我站在石堆西侧，向江上的渔翁询问桃源的去向。
桃花整日里随着清澈的溪水静静漂流，
传说中的那个桃源洞口，究竟在清溪的哪一边呢？
works.baihua: 隐隐飞桥隔野烟，石矶西畔问渔船。桃花尽日随流水，洞在清溪何处边？
en_lines: A soaring bridge looms dimly, veiled in the wild mist,
West of the rocky ledge I ask the fisherman in his boat.
All day long the peach blossoms drift upon the flowing stream,
Tell me, on which bank of this clear creek does the fabled cavern lie?

works.author: 张泌

baihua_lines: 离别之后，梦中仿佛又依依不舍地来到了你的家中。
小院里回廊曲折，栏杆依旧斜斜地横在那里。
只有春夜庭院上空的明月依然多情如旧，
还在为离别远去的我照着满地飘零的落花。
我深深怜爱清风明月，本是因为自己太多情，
每当春天到来，离别的愁绪便又油然而生。
倚着柱子默默思量往事，心中格外惆怅失意，
这一场春梦中的情景，竟已模糊得记不分明了。
works.baihua: 别梦依依到谢家。小廊回合曲阑斜。多情只有春庭月。犹为离人照落花。酷怜风月为多情。还到春时别恨生。倚柱寻思倍惆怅。一场春梦不分明。
en_lines: After our parting, in dreams I drifted longingly back to your home.
The winding corridor still curved, the crooked railings slanted as before.
Only the moon above the spring courtyard remains true in its affection,
Still shining on fallen petals for me, the one who went away.
I loved the wind and moon so deeply, all because of this tender heart,
Yet when spring comes round again, the pain of parting rises fresh.
Leaning against the pillar, lost in thought, my sorrow grows twofold,
And that spring dream I had — its scenes are now too dim to tell apart.

works.title: 何满子
works.author: 张祜
works.note: 【何满子】唐代张祜所作的诗。
works.tr: 雲雨常陪勝會，笙歌慣逐閑遊。錦里風光應占，玉鞭金勒驊騮。戴月潛穿深曲，和香醉脫輕裘。方喜正同鴛帳，又言將往皇州。每憶良宵公子伴，夢魂長挂紅樓。欲表傷離情味，丁香結在心頭。

baihua_lines: 行云布雨的时光常伴着热闹美好的宴会，
在笙箫歌舞中习惯了四处悠闲游乐。
锦官城的美好风光想来都曾被我占尽，
手持玉鞭、骑着配金勒的骏马恣意奔驰。
顶着月光悄悄穿过幽深曲折的小巷，
带着熏香醉意脱下身上轻薄的皮衣。
刚刚欢喜正和心上人同卧鸳帐之中，
却又听说你即将动身前往京城长安。
每当想起那些美好的夜晚有公子相伴，
我的梦魂就时常牵念在那座红楼之上。
想要表达离别后心头的感伤滋味，
就像丁香的花蕾一样，郁结缠绕在心头。
works.baihua: 云雨常陪胜会，笙歌惯逐闲游。锦里风光应占，玉鞭金勒骅骝。戴月潜穿深曲，和香醉脱轻裘。方喜正同鸳帐，又言将往皇州。每忆良宵公子伴，梦魂长挂红楼。欲表伤离情味，丁香结在心头。
en_lines: Cloud and rain oft graced our joyous gatherings,
To flutes and songs we wandered idly, leisured and free.
All the fair sights of Jinli's streets I seemed to claim,
With jade whip and golden bridle, our fine steeds raced ahead.
Beneath the moon we stole through winding, deep-set lanes,
Drunk with perfume, we cast aside our light fur gowns.
Just as I rejoiced to share the love-bird curtain with you,
Word came that you must journey to the imperial capital.
Whene'er I think of those fine nights in your company,
My dreaming soul still lingers in that red-painted tower.
To speak the bitter sorrow of our parting now,
A clove-like knot tightens, coiling within my heart.

works.title: 赠内人
works.author: 张祜
works.note: 【赠内人】唐代张祜所作的诗。
works.tr: 禁門宮樹月痕過，媚眼唯看宿燕窠。斜拔玉釵燈影畔，剔開紅焰救飛蛾。

她美丽的眼睛只默默凝视着梁上燕子的窝巢。

en_lines: Traces of moonlight drift past palace gates and trees,
Her lovely eyes rest only on the swallows' nest above.
Beside the lamp's shadow she draws her jade hairpin aslant,
And picks the red flame apart to save the moth within.

Red blossoms on the trees open to the morning dew.
Last night the Emperor newly bestowed the Taoist register,
And Taizhen came through the curtain with a smile upon her lips.

天刚亮就骑马进入了皇宫大门。
她嫌脂粉会弄脏自己天然的容颜，
只淡淡地描了描眉毛就去朝见皇帝。

en_lines: The Lady of Guo received the sovereign's gracious favour,
At dawn she rode her horse straight through the palace gates.
She thought that rouge and powder but stained her natural beauty,
So with a light touch on her brows she came before the throne.

works.title: 题金陵渡
works.author: 张祜
works.note: 【题金陵渡】唐代张祜所作的诗。
works.tr: 金陵津渡小山樓，一宿行人自可愁。潮落夜江斜月裏，兩三星火是瓜州。

baihua_lines: 在金陵渡口的小山上有一座小楼，
我这远行之人在此住了一夜，心中满是旅愁。
潮水退落的夜江上，斜月沉沉照着江面，
远处那几点闪烁的灯火，应该就是瓜洲了。
works.baihua: 金陵津渡小山楼，一宿行人自可愁。潮落夜江斜月里，两三星火是瓜州。
en_lines: At Jinling Ferry stands a little tower upon the hill,
A traveller lodging here for the night is drowned in gloom.
The tide has ebbed upon the night river beneath the slanting moon,
Those few faint glimmers of fire — that must be Guazhou in the dark.

works.author: 张籍

baihua_lines: 前年朝廷出兵征讨月支，
结果在城下全军覆没，无人归来。
蕃地与汉地之间断绝了消息，
你我生死相隔，成了永远的别离。
战场上废弃的营帐没有人收拾，
只有逃回来的战马还认得残破的军旗。
想要祭奠你，又隐约觉得你或许还在人世，
此时此刻我只能在天涯尽头失声痛哭。
works.baihua: 前年伐月支，城上没全师。蕃汉断消息，死生长别离。无人收废帐，归马识残旗。欲祭疑君在，天涯哭此时。
en_lines: Two years ago we marched against the Yuezhi tribes,
Beneath the city walls our entire host perished.
News between the Tartar lands and home was cut entirely,
Between the living and the dead sprang an eternal parting.
No one remained to gather up the abandoned tents,
Only returning horses still knew the tattered battle flags.
I would pour a libation, yet half-believe you still alive,
Here at the world's far end I weep for you this hour.

works.author: 张继

baihua_lines: 月亮已落下乌鸦啼叫，寒霜布满了天空，
江边的枫树和渔船的灯火，伴着我忧愁难眠。
半夜敲响的钟声悠悠传到了我乘坐的客船。
寒冷的夜晚有客人来访，以茶当酒招待，
竹炉上汤水翻滚，炉火刚刚烧得通红。
窗前的月光和平日看起来没有什么两样，
只是因为有了梅花，便觉得气氛全然不同。
works.baihua: 月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠。姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船。寒夜杜小山寒夜客来茶当酒，竹炉汤沸火初红。寻常一样窗前月，才有梅花便不同。
en_lines: The moon has set, crows cry out, and frost fills all the sky,
By riverside maples and fishing boat lights I lie sleepless in sorrow.
Beyond the city of Suzhou stands Hanshan Temple,
Its midnight bell comes echoing to my traveller's boat.
Night now here there still yet still.
Mountain now here there still yet still.
On a cold night a guest arrived, we made tea to serve as wine,
Water boiled in the bamboo stove, the fire just turned glowing red.
The moonlight at the window looked no different from before,
Yet with the plum blossoms there, the whole scene felt changed indeed.

works.title: 江乡故人偶集客舍
works.author: 戴叔伦

baihua_lines: 秋夜的天空中，月亮又一次圆满了，
京城的夜色被层层夜幕笼罩着。
我们居然还能像在江南时那样聚会，
反而怀疑这次相逢是在梦中。
风吹动树枝，惊起了暗夜里栖息的乌鹊，
沾满露水的草丛中，寒虫在悲鸣哭泣。
漂泊在外的日子，就该长醉不愿醒，
大家相互挽留，只怕听见破晓的钟声。
works.baihua: 天秋月又满，城阙夜千重。还作江南会，翻疑梦里逢。风枝惊暗鹊，露草泣寒虫。羁旅长堪醉，相留畏晓钟。
en_lines: Beneath the autumn sky the moon is full once more,
A thousand folds of night enshroud the capital's walls.
That we should gather again as we did in the south,
Makes me half-suspect this meeting is but a dream.
Wind stirs the branches, startling magpies in the dark,
On dew-damp grass cold insects weep their mournful cries.
In travel far from home one should drink deep and long,
We cling together, dreading the dawn bell that will part us.

works.title: 杂诗
works.author: 无名氏
works.note: 【秋风】秋天的风，多与萧瑟、离别、思乡相连。；【杂诗】唐代无名氏所作的诗。
works.tr: 近寒食雨草萋萋。着麦苗风栁映堤。等是有家归未得。杜鹃休向耳边啼。浙江轻浪古悠悠。望海楼吹望海愁。莫怪乡心随魄断。十年为客在他州。无定河边暮笛声。赫连台畔旅人情。函闗归路千余里。一夕秋风白髪生。花落长川草色青。暮山重迭雨冥冥。逢春便觉飘蓬苦。今日分飞一涕零。

baihua_lines: 临近寒食节，细雨绵绵，青草长得十分茂盛。
麦苗迎风摆动，岸边柳树相映成荫。
同样都是有家却回不去的游子啊，
杜鹃鸟啊，请不要在我耳边不停啼叫了。
浙江的轻柔波浪悠悠荡荡流淌了千年，
登上望海楼，吹起的风都满载望乡的哀愁。
不要怪我思乡的心魂都快随魂魄碎断，
毕竟我已经在异乡漂泊了整整十年。
无定河边传来日暮时分悠远的笛声，
赫连台边满是旅人怀乡的愁情。
函谷关的归路远在千余里之外，
一夜秋风吹过，头上顿时生出了白发。
花瓣落在长河里，两岸草色青青一片，
傍晚山峦重重叠叠，细雨蒙蒙下个不停。
每逢春天就深深感到飘泊如蓬草的苦楚，
今日在这里分别，忍不住泪水簌簌落下。

en_lines: Near Cold Food Festival, soft rain falls, the grass grows lush and green,
Wind sways the wheat shoots, willows shade the dyke in tender lines.
We are alike, you and I — wanderers with homes we cannot reach,
O cuckoo, cease your crying by my ear, I beg you now.
Light waves on the Zhe River have rolled on through ancient years,
From Wanghai Tower the wind blows laden with homesick grief.
Do not marvel that my homesick heart is broken with longing,
For ten long years I have sojourned in a foreign land.
By the Wuding River a flute sounds at close of day,
By Helian Terrace the traveller's sorrows rise.
Homeward through Hangu Pass lies a thousand miles and more,
One night of autumn wind, and white hair springs upon my head.
Blossoms fall on the long river, the banks are fresh with green,
Twilight mountains rise in tiers beneath a misty, drizzling sky.
Come spring I feel the bitter hurt of the drifting dandelion,
As we part today my tears fall freely and unbidden.

works.author: 朱庆余
works.note: 【宫词】唐代朱庆余所作的诗。
works.tr: 寂寂花时闭院门。美人相并立琼轩。含情欲说宫中事。鹦鹉前头不敢言。
works.appr: 《宫词》是唐代朱庆余所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「寂寂花时闭院门。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《宫词》历代传诵不衰，是朱庆余诗歌风格的集中体现。

【承】第二句承接延展，铺陈画面与情境。
【转】第三句转折递进，情感或视角翻出新意。

works.img:
【花】花意象，喻美好青春，落花则有伤春、惜逝之意。

【门】门扉意象，或等归人，或闭深山，意味隽永。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
works.bg: 《宫词》为唐代朱庆余所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者朱庆余在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
works.theme: 《宫词》主旨在于歌咏爱情与相思之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代朱庆余的代表性作品之一。

美丽的宫人们并肩站在华丽的轩窗之下。

en_lines: In the season of blooming flowers the courtyard gates stand silently shut,
Fair palace maidens stand side by side beneath the ornate veranda rail.
Their hearts brim with things they would tell of life within the palace,
But before the parrot perched nearby, none dares speak a single word.

等到天亮就要到堂前去拜见公婆。
梳妆完毕她低声询问自己的丈夫：
我画的眉毛深浅是否符合如今的流行样式？
works.baihua: 洞房昨夜停红烛。待晓堂前拜舅姑。妆罢低声问夫婿。画眉深浅入时无。
en_lines: Last night in the bridal chamber red candles burned till dawn,
Awaiting daylight to pay respects to parents in the hall.
When her toilette was done she whispered to her husband,
"Are my painted eyebrows fashionable — too dark or too light?"

works.title: 玉台体
works.author: 权德舆
works.note: 【玉台体】唐代权德舆所作的诗。
works.tr: 捲幔燈千朶，鈎簾月半弓。繡鴛翔瀝水，金雀跂屏風。細意翩長袖，多情結短封。銅壺從婉娩，玉珮正丁東。
works.appr: 《玉台体》是唐代权德舆所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《玉台体》历代传诵不衰，是权德舆诗歌风格的集中体现。

【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。

baihua_lines: 卷起帘幔，千盏灯火亮得如同花朵一般，
钩起窗帘，一弯月牙如弓挂在夜空。
绣着鸳鸯的图案在水波之上翩翩飞翔，
金制的雀形钗子翘立在屏风之前。
情意绵绵地舞动着翩翩长袖，
满含深情地封好短短的情书。
铜壶滴漏的声音婉转悠长，
身上的玉佩正叮咚作响。
works.baihua: 卷幔灯千朶，钩帘月半弓。绣鸳翔沥水，金雀跂屏风。细意翩长袖，多情结短封。铜壶从婉娩，玉珮正丁东。
en_lines: Rolling back the curtains, a thousand lamps bloom like flowers,
Hooking up the blind, the crescent moon hangs like a bow.
Embroidered mandarin ducks seem to dance across the rippling water,
Golden bird-shaped hairpins rise before the painted screen.
With tender feeling she flutters her long sleeves gracefully,
And full of affection seals a short letter for her love.
The copper water-clock pours out its gentle, winding sound,
While jade pendants at her waist chime softly, ding-dong.

works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【为有】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

en_lines: Behind the mica screen the lady is infinitely fair,
The capital's cold has lifted, yet she dreads the short spring night.
Without cause she wed a high official, a lord of golden seal,
Who leaves her perfumed quilt warm and empty, to attend dawn court.

works.author: 李商隐

baihua_lines: 客人离去后，江水涨平了栏杆，
蝉声停歇，枝头挂满了夜露。
在这个时节我久久地思念着你，
倚着栏杆站立，不知不觉过了许久。
北斗星随着春天一同远去了，
南陵那边送信的人迟迟未至。
在天涯之外我一次次占卜梦境，
疑心你是不是有了新交的知己，把我忘了。
works.baihua: 客去波平槛，蝉休露满枝。永怀当此节，倚立自移时。北斗兼春远，南陵寓使迟。天涯占梦数，疑误有新知。
en_lines: After the guest departed, the river rose level with the rail,
The cicadas fell silent, dew weighed heavy on the branches.
At this season my thoughts dwell upon you endlessly,
Leaning here I have stood still as the hours slipped by.
The Northern Dipper has grown far away, as spring receded,
The messenger from Nanling still comes not, long delayed.
At the world's end I divine the meaning of my dreams,
Fearing perhaps you have found new friends and forgotten me.

works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【北青萝】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 夕阳从西边落入崦嵫山中，
我到茅屋中去拜访一位孤居的僧人。
落叶纷纷，不知僧人到哪里去了，
寒云缭绕的山路不知还要走几层。
初夜时分他独自敲响了寺里的磬声，
安闲地倚着一根藤杖伫立。
整个世界都在一粒微尘之中，
我又何必再去执著于爱与憎呢？
works.baihua: 残阳西入崦，茅屋访孤僧。落叶人何在，寒云路几层。独敲初夜磬，闲倚一枝藤。世界微尘里，吾宁爱与憎。
en_lines: The setting sun has sunk westward behind Yanzi Mountain,
I sought a lone monk dwelling in his thatched hut.
Fallen leaves are everywhere — where has the master gone?
Through cold cloud-shrouded paths I climb, tier after tier.
At early nightfall alone he strikes the temple's qing stone,
Then leans at leisure on a single staff of rattan.
The whole great world lies within a single grain of dust,
Why then should I still cling to love and to hate?

works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【夜雨寄北】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

今夜巴山正下着大雨，秋水涨满了池塘。

en_lines: You ask me when I shall return — I have no date to give you yet.
Tonight on Ba Mountain the autumn rain swells the ponds.
When shall we together trim the candle by the west window,
And talk of this Ba Mountain night, this rain, this longing for you?

works.baihua: 云母屏风烛影深。长河渐落晓星沉。嫦娥应悔偷灵药。碧海青天夜夜心。
en_lines: Upon the mica screen the candle shadows grow deeper still,
The Silver River slants westward, the morning star sinks low.
Chang'e must rue the day she stole the immortal elixir,
For now the blue sea and sky bear her lonely heart company each night.

你千里迢迢寄来一封书信，由双鲤传递。

en_lines: Clouds of Song Mountain, trees of Qin — long have we dwelt apart,
A pair of carp has brought your letter across a thousand miles.
Ask not of me, the old guest of Liang Garden, how I fare,
I am like Xiangru, ill in Maoling as autumn rains fall.

她吹着箫、骑着仙鹤飞上了青天。
归来之后亲自采摘金茎上的仙露，
亲手书写着一卷《黄庭经》。

en_lines: Her moon-shaped comb lies sideways, her hair tresses slant aslant,
She plays the flute and rides a crane up to the azure sky.
Returning, she picks the dew from the golden stem herself,
And copies by hand the Yellow Court Scripture, one scroll.

works.title: 无题·凤尾香罗
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【无题·凤尾香罗】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 织着凤尾花纹的香罗帐薄了一层又一层，
深夜里她还在缝着绣着碧纹的圆顶帐子。
月轮形状的团扇遮住了含羞的脸却难以遮掩，
车声如雷隆隆而过，终究没能说上一句话。
曾度过多少寂寞时光，灯花烧尽暗淡无光，
始终没有你的消息，石榴花已经红了一年。
你的斑骓马就拴在垂杨岸边，
什么时候能有一阵西南好风把你吹到我身旁。

en_lines: The phoenix-patterned fragrant gauze curtains are thin, fold on fold,
Deep in the night she sews the round green-patterned canopy.
The moon-shaped fan hides her blushing face but cannot hide it quite,
His carriage rumbles past like thunder, no word is ever exchanged.
How many lonely hours have passed, the lamp's gold embers darkening,
No word ever comes from him, while pomegranate blossoms redden again.
His piebald horse is tethered to the willow bank over there,
When will a fair southwestern wind blow him back to my side?

baihua_lines: 昨夜星光灿烂，昨夜暖风习习，
我们相会在画楼西侧、桂堂之东。
身上虽然没有彩凤那样可以双飞的翅膀，
心灵却像灵异的犀牛角一样息息相通。
隔着座位玩藏钩游戏，春酒暖人心房，
分成小组玩射覆游戏，红烛灯火通明。
可叹我听见报晓鼓声就要前去官府应差，
骑着马赶到兰台，活像随风飘转的蓬草。
works.baihua: 昨夜星辰昨夜风，画楼西畔桂堂东。身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通。隔座送钩春酒暖，分曹射复蜡灯红。嗟余听鼓应官去，走马兰台类转蓬。
en_lines: Last night the stars shone bright, last night the breezes blew warm,
We met west of the painted tower, east of the cinnamon hall.
Though I have no phoenix wings to fly and join you there,
Our hearts communicate as the magic rhinoceros horn perceives all.
Across the seats we passed the hook in the warm spring wine,
We sat in teams at guessing games beneath the red candle glow.
Alas! I hear the dawn drums call me to my official post,
I gallop to Lantai like a dandelion tumbling in the wind.

baihua_lines: 你说要来终究是空话，一去之后便没了踪迹，
月亮斜挂楼上，五更的钟声已经敲响。
梦中因为远别而悲泣，却难以将你唤回，
墨还没磨浓就被催着匆匆写成了书信。
烛光半照着绣有金翡翠的帷幕，
麝香的气息微微飘到绣着芙蓉的被褥上。
刘郎当年已经怨恨蓬山遥远难寻，
而你我之间却隔着一万重蓬山！
works.baihua: 来是空言去绝踪，月斜楼上五更钟。梦为远别啼难唤，书被催成墨未浓。蜡照半笼金翡翠，麝熏微度绣芙蓉。刘郎已恨蓬山远，更隔蓬山一万重！
en_lines: "I'll come" were empty words; once gone, you left no trace,
The moon slants on the tower, the fifth watch bell has rung.
In dreams I wept at our far parting, yet could not call you back,
My letter was urgently writ before the ink was dark.
Candlelight half-illumines the curtains of golden kingfisher,
Musk fragrance drifts softly across the lotus-embroidered quilt.
Liu Lang of old already grieved that Penglai Mountain was far,
But between us lie ten thousand folds of that same fairy mountain!

works.title: 无题·相见时难
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【无题·相见时难】唐代李商隐所作的诗。
works.tr: 相见时难别亦难，东风无力百花残。春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干。晓镜但愁云鬓改，夜吟应觉月光寒。蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看。

baihua_lines: 相见的时候难得，分别的时候更是难舍难分，
东风将尽，百花也都凋残零落了。
春蚕直到死去的时候才会把丝吐尽，
蜡烛直到烧成灰烬的时候蜡泪才会流干。
早晨对镜梳妆，只担忧鬓发改变了颜色，
夜里独自吟诗，应该会感到月光分外清寒。
蓬莱仙境离这里并没有多少路程，
希望青鸟能殷勤地为我前去探看消息。
works.baihua: 相见时难别亦难，东风无力百花残。春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干。晓镜但愁云鬓改，夜吟应觉月光寒。蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看。
en_lines: Hard it is to meet, harder still to part when we must,
The east wind fades its strength, and all the flowers have fallen.
The spring silkworm spins its thread till death itself does come,
The candle's tears dry only when it has burned to ash.
At dawn before the mirror I grieve to see my cloudlike hair change,
Chanting verse at night, I know the moonlight must feel cold to you.
Penglai Mountain is not so very far from here,
O Bluebird, go often as messenger and bring me word of her!

works.title: 无题·重帏深下
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。；【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。
works.tr: 重帏深下莫愁堂，卧后清宵细细长。神女生涯原是梦，小姑居处本无郎。风波不信菱枝弱，月露谁教桂叶香。直道相思了无益，未妨惆怅是清狂。

baihua_lines: 层层帷幕深深垂下，在莫愁姑娘的堂上，
她卧在床上，只觉得清静的夜晚分外悠长。
巫山神女的故事原本就只是一场梦幻，
小姑居住的地方本就没有如意郎君相伴。
风波从不肯相信菱枝那般柔弱，
月中的桂叶飘香又是谁赐予的呢。
就算相思之情全然没有益处，
也不妨把这一份惆怅当作痴情的疏狂。

en_lines: Behind deep-folded curtains in young Mochou's chamber,
She lies awake as the quiet night drags slowly on and on.
The Goddess of Wu Mountain's tale was nothing but a dream,
The young girl lived alone, no young man shared her dwelling place.
Wind and waves refuse to believe how frail the water-chestnut stems,
And who commanded moonlit dew to scent the cassia leaves?
Even if this longing be entirely in vain,
It is no harm to let this melancholy be a gentle madness.

works.author: 李商隐

baihua_lines: 东风飒飒地吹，细雨蒙蒙地下，
荷花塘外传来了轻轻的雷声。
金蟾咬着锁，香烟还是可以飘进炉中，
玉虎形的辘轳牵着井绳把水汲回家里。
贾氏在帘后偷看韩寿，是爱他年少貌美，
宓妃留枕给魏王，是爱慕他绝世文才。
春心啊，千万不要和百花争着开放，
一寸寸的相思都会化作一寸寸的灰烬！
works.baihua: 飒飒东风细雨来，芙蓉塘外有轻雷。金蟾啮锁烧香入，玉虎牵丝汲井回。贾氏窥帘韩掾少，宓妃留枕魏王才。春心莫共花争发，一寸相思一寸灰！
en_lines: The east wind rustles, a fine misty rain is falling,
Beyond the lotus pond a gentle roll of thunder sounds.
Through golden toad lock-bites the incense smoke drifts in,
The jade-tiger pulley draws well-water on its rope.
Lady Jia spied through the curtain on Han Shou for his youthful grace,
The River Princess left her pillow for the Prince of Wei's poetic talent.
Let not your spring heart vie with flowers in budding forth,
For every inch of longing turns an inch of hope to ash!

works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【春雨】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 春日里我披着白夹衫怅然躺在床上，
白门这个地方冷冷落落，事事都不如意。
隔着蒙蒙细雨遥望红楼，只觉一片清冷，
珠帘般的细雨飘在灯前，我独自踏上归路。
远在他方的你应该为春光迟暮而伤悲吧，
在这残夜将尽时我还能在梦中依稀见到你。
玉珰和书信怎样才能送到你的手中呢？
万里长空阴云密布，只见一只孤雁飞过。
works.baihua: 怅卧新春白袷衣，白门寥落意多违。红楼隔雨相望冷，珠箔飘灯独自归。远路应悲春晼晚，残宵犹得梦依稀。玉珰缄札何由达，万里云罗一雁飞。
en_lines: In early spring I lie disconsolate in my plain white robe,
The White Gate stands deserted, all things go against my wish.
Across the rain I gaze toward the red tower, feeling cold,
Through bead-curtain rain beneath the lamp I turn back home alone.
On distant roads you must grieve that spring is waning late,
In the last hours of night I still glimpse you faintly in my dreams.
How can these jade earrings and letter ever reach your hands?
Through ten thousand miles of cloud only a lone wild goose flies.

works.title: 瑶池
works.author: 李商隐

works.tr: 瑶池阿母绮窓开。黄竹歌声动地哀。八骏日行三万里。穆王何事不重来。

en_lines: By Jasper Lake the Queen Mother throws her ornate window open,
The Yellow Bamboo songs resound across the earth with mournful sound.
The Emperor's eight fine steeds could run thirty thousand li a day,
What business kept him, that he never came again?

baihua_lines: 园中的祠庙是何年荒废掉的，
登上此处还能看到旧日的山丘。
孤零零的村庄连日来都十分安静，
下了许久的大雨终于停歇了。
这里一直与秦地的山峰遥遥相对，
当年汉代的帝王也曾到此游历。
哪里知道千年之后的今天，
万事都如同流水向东逝去一般。

en_lines: When did the gardens and the shrines fall into ruin?
Climbing up, one sees the ancient burial mounds still there.
The lone village has lain quiet for many days together,
The long, unceasing rains have finally come to an end.
It has faced the Qin mountains through the centuries,
Han emperors once wandered here in days of old.
Who could have known that after a thousand years would pass,
All things would flow eastward like a river, gone for good?

baihua_lines: 猿猴和飞鸟至今似乎还畏惧着诸葛亮严明的军令，
风云也常常围护着他当年驻扎时的营垒。
徒然让上将在这里挥动神妙的笔谋划军事，
最终还是见到后主刘禅坐着驿车投降离去。
诸葛亮有管仲、乐毅那样的才能，实在当之无愧，
可是关羽张飞都已死去，他又能怎么办呢？
往年经过锦官城的武侯祠庙，
写完《梁父吟》，心头仍留有无尽遗恨。
works.baihua: 猿鸟犹疑畏简书，风云常为护储胥。徒令上将挥神笔，终见降王走传车。管乐有才终不忝，关张无命欲何如。他年锦里经祠庙，梁父吟成恨有余。
en_lines: Apes and birds still seem to fear Zhuge Liang's stern commands of old,
Wind and cloud still guard the ramparts where his army camped.
In vain did the great general wave his godlike brush of strategy,
In the end he saw the captive king carried off in a post-house cart.
With Guan Zhong and Yue Yi's talent he was truly worthy of compare,
But Guan and Zhang fell to fate — what then could he achieve?
In years gone by I visited his shrine in Jinli's streets,
After chanting Liangfu Yin, my heart remained heavy with regret.

works.title: 落花
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【落花】唐代李商隐所作的诗。
works.tr: 高閣客竟去，小園花亂飛。參差連曲陌，迢遰送斜暉。腸斷未忍掃，眼穿仍欲歸。芳心向春盡，所得是沾衣。

baihua_lines: 高阁上的客人终于都离去了，
小园中的落花漫天纷飞。
曲曲折折的小路上落满了参差的花瓣，
远远地送走了夕阳的余晖。
我心肠寸断，不忍心把落花扫去，
望眼欲穿地盼着春天归来，春还是要离去。
美好的芳心随着春天一同耗尽了，
最终得到的只有沾满衣襟的泪水。
works.baihua: 高阁客竟去，小园花乱飞。参差连曲陌，迢遰送斜晖。肠断未忍扫，眼穿仍欲归。芳心向春尽，所得是沾衣。
en_lines: At last the guests have gone from the high pavilion,
Across the little garden flowers fly in wild disarray.
They scatter unevenly along the winding paths,
Bidding farewell far and wide to the slanting sunset glow.
Heart-broken, I cannot bear to sweep them from the ground,
My eyes strain for spring's return, yet spring prepares to leave.
The fair heart of the flowers exhausts itself with spring,
And all it gains are tears that wet the folds of my gown.

works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【蝉】唐代李商隐所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 蝉本来就因为栖身高处而难以吃饱，
它的声声哀鸣全都是徒劳无功。
五更天的时候蝉声稀疏得几乎要断绝，
那一树碧绿的枝叶却依旧冷漠无情。
我官小职微，像桃梗一样四处飘泊，
故园的田地早已荒芜得杂草齐平。
多谢蝉的鸣声提醒了我，
我也应当如你一般全家保持清贫高洁。
works.baihua: 本以高难饱，徒劳恨费声。五更疎欲断，一树碧无情。薄宦梗犹泛，故园芜已平。烦君最相警，我亦举家清。
en_lines: You dwell on high branches, cicada, and thus can scarce eat your fill,
And yet you pour out plaintive cries, all spent and all in vain.
At the fifth watch your song grows thin, about to fail,
While the green tree's leaves remain as cold and heartless as ever.
A petty official, I drift like a wooden puppet on the tide,
My home garden has long run wild, overgrown with weeds.
I thank you for your warning, uttered in your song,
I too shall keep my household pure, honest, and poor.

贾谊的才华格调实在是无人能比。
可惜谈到半夜，汉文帝空自挪动坐席靠前，
他问的不是天下百姓的疾苦，而是关于鬼神的事。

en_lines: Emperor Wen sought out worthy ministers, summoning the exiled scholar,
Jia Yi's talent and bearing were beyond compare in his age.
Alas! At midnight he leaned forward on his mat in vain,
Asking not of the people's welfare, but of ghosts and deities.

works.title: 锦瑟
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【锦瑟】唐代李商隐所作的诗。
works.tr: 錦瑟無端五十絃，一絃一柱思華年。莊生曉夢迷蝴蝶，望帝春心託杜鵑。滄海月明珠有淚，藍田日暖玉生煙。此情可待成追憶，只是當時已惘然。

baihua_lines: 锦瑟为什么无缘无故就有五十根弦呢？
每一根弦、每一柱都让我追忆逝去的青春年华。
庄周在清晨做梦，迷茫中分不清自己是蝴蝶还是庄周，
望帝把一片春心和悲怨托付给啼血的杜鹃。
明月照耀着沧海，珍珠仿佛是鲛人落下的眼泪，
在蓝田温暖的日光下，美玉化作轻烟缭绕。
这种感情哪里等到今日追忆时才觉得怅惘呢？
其实在当时就已经令人感到惘然若失了。
works.baihua: 锦瑟无端五十弦，一弦一柱思华年。庄生晓梦迷蝴蝶，望帝春心托杜鹃。沧海月明珠有泪，蓝田日暖玉生烟。此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然。
en_lines: Why does the ornate zither have fifty strings for no reason?
Each string and bridge recalls the years of my bright youth.
Zhuangzi dreamed at dawn, confused if he were butterfly or man,
King Wang entrusted his springtime heart to the cuckoo's tears.
Beneath the bright moon the dark sea holds pearls like mermaid tears,
In Lantian's warm sunlight jade dissolves in wispy smoke.
This feeling did not wait for remembrance to grow into regret,
Even then, at the very time, it already felt like a lost dream.

works.title: 隋宫
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【天涯】天的尽头，指极远之地，常与漂泊、相思相连。；【隋宫】唐代李商隐所作的诗。
works.tr: 紫泉宮殿鎖煙霞，欲取蕪城作帝家。玉璽不緣歸日角，錦帆應是到天涯。于今腐草無螢火，終古垂楊有暮鴉。地下若逢陳後主，豈宜重問後庭花。

baihua_lines: 长安的紫泉宫殿空自锁在烟霞之中，
隋炀帝想把江都当作自己永久的帝王之家。
如果不是玉玺落到了李渊（日角龙庭）手中，
他的锦帆龙舟恐怕会飘到天涯海角。
如今放萤取乐的腐草中再也没有萤火虫了，
只有隋堤上的垂杨里，黄昏时乌鸦栖息啼叫。
如果在地下遇见了亡国的陈后主，
难道还好意思再问起《后庭花》吗？
works.baihua: 紫泉宫殿锁烟霞，欲取芜城作帝家。玉玺不缘归日角，锦帆应是到天涯。于今腐草无萤火，终古垂杨有暮鸦。地下若逢陈后主，岂宜重问后庭花。
en_lines: Ziquan Palace in Chang'an stands locked in clouds and rosy mist,
The Emperor wished to make Wucheng his eternal imperial home.
Had the jade seal not passed to the lord with dragon-like brow,
His brocade sails might have sailed on to the very ends of the earth.
Today in the rotting grass no fireflies remain where he released them,
Only evening rooks still nest in the ancient willows of Sui's dyke.
If underground he should meet the conquered lord of Chen,
How could he bear to ask again for the Backyard Flowers song?

works.title: 韩碑
works.author: 李商隐
works.note: 【韩碑】唐代李商隐所作的诗。
works.tr: 元和天子神武姿，彼何人啊軒與羲。誓將上雪列聖恥，坐法宮中朝四夷。淮西有賊五十載，封狼生貙貙生羆。不據山河據平地，長戈利矛日可麾。帝得聖相相曰度，賊斫不死神扶持。腰懸相印作都統，陰風慘澹天王旗。愬武古通作牙爪，儀曹外郎載筆隨。行軍司馬智且勇，十四萬衆猶虎貔。入蔡縛賊獻太廟，功無與讓恩不訾。帝曰汝度功第一，汝從事愈宜爲辭。愈拜稽首蹈且舞，金石刻畫臣能爲。古者世稱大手筆，此事不繫于職司。當仁自古有不讓，言訖屢頷天子頤。公退齋戒坐小閣，濡染大筆何淋漓。點竄堯典舜典字，塗改清廟生民詩。文成破體書在紙，清晨再拜鋪丹墀。表曰臣愈昧死上，詠神聖功書之碑。碑高三丈字如斗，負以靈鼇蟠以螭。句奇語重喻者少，讒之天子言其私。長繩百尺拽碑倒，麤砂大石相磨治。公之斯文若元氣，先時已入人肝脾。湯盤孔鼎有述作，今無其器存其辭。嗚呼聖皇及聖相，相與烜赫流淳熙。公之斯文不示後，曷與三五相攀追。願書萬本誦萬過，口角流沫右手胝。傳之七十有二代，以爲封禪玉檢明堂基。

notes.explanation: 唐代李商隐所作的诗。

works.translation: 元和天子神武姿，彼何人啊軒與羲。誓將上雪列聖恥，坐法宮中朝四夷。淮西有賊五十載，封狼生貙貙生羆。不據山河據平地，長戈利矛日可麾。帝得聖相相曰度，賊斫不死神扶持。腰懸相印作都統，陰風慘澹天王旗。愬武古通作牙爪，儀曹外郎載筆隨。行軍司馬智且勇，十四萬衆猶虎貔。入蔡縛賊獻太廟，功無與讓恩不訾。帝曰汝度功第一，汝從事愈宜爲辭。愈拜稽首蹈且舞，金石刻畫臣能爲。古者世稱大手筆，此事不繫于職司。當仁自古有不讓，言訖屢頷天子頤。公退齋戒坐小閣，濡染大筆何淋漓。點竄堯典舜典字，塗改清廟生民詩。文成破體書在紙，清晨再拜鋪丹墀。表曰臣愈昧死上，詠神聖功書之碑。碑高三丈字如斗，負以靈鼇蟠以螭。句奇語重喻者少，讒之天子言其私。長繩百尺拽碑倒，麤砂大石相磨治。公之斯文若元氣，先時已入人肝脾。湯盤孔鼎有述作，今無其器存其辭。嗚呼聖皇及聖相，相與烜赫流淳熙。公之斯文不示後，曷與三五相攀追。願書萬本誦萬過，口角流沫右手胝。傳之七十有二代，以爲封禪玉檢明堂基。
works.appreciation: 《韩碑》是唐代李商隐所作的诗名篇。全诗共52句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《韩碑》历代传诵不衰，是李商隐诗歌风格的集中体现。
works.structure:
【起·开篇】前13句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第14至26句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第27至39句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末13句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。
works.imagery:
【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【河】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【雪】霜雪意象，既写冬景，也喻白发、苦寒、高洁。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。

baihua_lines: 元和天子有着神武英武的英姿，
他可以和古代的圣君轩辕、伏羲相比。
他发誓要洗雪列位圣君蒙受的耻辱，
坐在法宫中接受四方蛮夷的朝见。
淮西一带的藩镇割据已经有五十年了，
就像大狼生下貙，貙又生下罴一样代代凶恶。
他们不据守高山大河，而是占据平原之地，
拿着长戈利矛，气焰嚣张到可以挥退太阳。
皇帝得到了一位圣明的宰相名叫裴度，
贼人刺杀他没能杀死，真是有神灵护佑。
腰里挂着相印担任大军都统，
天王旗下阴风惨淡，气象肃穆。
李愬、韩弘、李道古、李文通作为猛将辅佐，
礼部的员外郎带着笔随行掌管文书。
担任行军司马的韩愈智勇双全，
十四万大军如同虎貔一样勇猛无比。
攻入蔡州擒获叛贼，将俘虏献到太庙，
他的功劳无人能比，朝廷的恩赏也不可估量。
皇帝说：裴度，你的功劳当属第一，
你的从事韩愈应当撰写碑文来记述此事。
韩愈跪拜叩头，手舞足蹈地说：
撰写金石铭刻的文章正是臣子所能做的。
自古以来能写这种大文章的就叫大手笔，
这样的重任不应该交给普通的文学之职。
自古以来当仁不让，臣愿承担此事，
说完之后皇帝频频点头赞许。
韩公退下之后斋戒沐浴坐在小阁之中，
挥动大笔，写得酣畅淋漓。
笔法上点窜运用《尧典》《舜典》的文字，
化用《清庙》《生民》这些经典诗篇的笔法。
文章写成用变体书写在纸上，
清晨时再拜将它铺在宫殿的丹墀之上。
上表说：臣韩愈冒死上奏，
要将神圣的功绩刻写在石碑上。
用灵鳌来背负，碑上盘绕着螭龙。
文句奇特、语义深重，能理解的人很少，
有人就在天子面前进谗言，说韩愈写碑文徇私情。
于是用百尺长绳把石碑拽倒，
用粗沙大石把碑文磨平磨光。
韩公的这篇文章如同天地间的元气，
早已经深入人心，渗入人的肝脾。
商汤的盘、孔子的鼎上都有铭文流传后世，
如今器物虽不存，铭文却留存人间。
啊！圣明的天子和圣明的宰相，
声威显赫，光照后世，流传淳正清明。
韩公的文章如果不能流传给后人，
又怎能与三皇五帝的功绩相攀追呢？
我愿抄写一万本，诵读一万遍，
哪怕口角流沫、右手磨出老茧也心甘情愿。
作为封禅大典的玉检、明堂的基石。

en_lines: The Emperor of Yuanhe possessed a divine and martial bearing,
What men were those? Huangdi and Fuxi, his ancient peers.
He swore to wipe away the shame of all his ancestors before him,
And sit in his palace court receiving homage from all four quarters.
For fifty years the rebels of Huaixi had held their ground,
Great wolves bore wildcats, and those wildcats bore great bears.
They held not mountains or rivers but the open plains,
Long halberds and sharp spears waved high as if to sweep the sun.
Then the Emperor found a wise minister whose name was Du,
Assassins struck him down in vain, the gods upheld his life.
The minister's seal at his waist, he took command of all the hosts,
Beneath the Son of Heaven's flags a cold, stern wind did blow.
Su, Wu, Gu, and Tong served as his claws and teeth,
With brush in hand the secretariat's scholars followed close behind.
As administrator of the army, Han Yu was both wise and brave,
A hundred and forty thousand warriors fierce as tigers marched.
They entered Cai, seized the rebel, presented him at the ancestral shrine,
His merit stood unmatched, rewards beyond all measure flowed.
The Emperor said: "Du, your merit stands the first of all,
And you, your aide Han Yu, shall write the words in praise."
Han Yu bowed his head, kowtowed, and danced for very joy,
"To inscribe on bronze and stone — this your servant can do well.
Since ancient times such writings have been called the great hand's work,
And for such task the regular post of letters will not suffice.
When duty calls, a man of old did not shrink from it,"
When he had spoken, the Emperor nodded his approval oft.
The lord retired, fasted and bathed, sat in his little chamber,
He dipped his mighty brush and wrote, in free and flowing strokes.
He wove in phrases from the Canon of Yao and Canon of Shun,
And drew upon the verses of Qingmiao and Shengmin old.
When the piece was done, written in a bold new script on paper,
At dawn he bowed again and spread it on the crimson palace steps.
His memorial read: "Your servant Yu, risking death, presents this,
Of sacred, holy merit to be inscribed upon a stone."
The stone stood three zhang high, its characters as large as pecks,
Borne by a sacred tortoise, coiled about with dragon carvings.
Strange its lines and weighty its words, few could grasp their meaning,
Slanderers told the Emperor that private spite had marred the work.
Long ropes a hundred feet were brought to pull the monument down,
With coarse sand and great stones they ground its inscriptions smooth.
This writing of our lord was like the primal breath of heaven and earth,
It had already entered deep into the hearts and souls of men.
Tang's basin and Confucius' tripod bore inscriptions long ago,
Though the vessels perished, their words still live among us now.
Alas! The sacred Emperor and his sacred minister,
Together shone in glory, spreading pure and radiant light.
Should this writing of our lord not be shown to ages after,
How could they hope to match the three and five sage kings of old?
I would copy it ten thousand times, recite it ten thousand times over,
Until my mouth doth foam and my right hand grows thick with callus.
Let it be passed down through seventy-two generations,
To serve as jade cap of the fengshan rite, as cornerstone of Bright Hall.

works.tr: 淒涼寶劍篇，羈泊欲窮年。黃葉仍風雨，青樓自管絃。新知遭薄俗，舊好隔良緣。心斷新豐酒，銷愁斗幾千。

baihua_lines: 我凄凉地吟诵着《宝剑篇》，
漂泊羁旅只怕要这样度过余年。
枯黄的树叶依然在风雨中飘零，
青楼里却自顾自地响着管弦歌舞之声。
新交的朋友遭到浅薄世俗的非难，
旧日的好友又因为缘分阻隔难以相见。
想要用新丰美酒来断绝心中的愁闷，
可是一斗酒要价十千，用来消愁又要花多少钱？
works.baihua: 凄凉宝剑篇，羁泊欲穷年。黄叶仍风雨，青楼自管弦。新知遭薄俗，旧好隔良缘。心断新丰酒，销愁斗几千。
en_lines: I chant the Song of the Precious Sword with a heavy heart,
A wanderer in this world, likely to live out my years adrift.
Yellow leaves still twist and fall beneath the wind and rain,
While from the blue mansions flutes and strings sound on unheeding.
Newly made friends are slandered by a heartless, vulgar world,
Old, dear companions are kept far by fate's unkind design.
My heart breaks but to think of Xinfeng wine to drown my cares,
A single measure costs a thousand coins — how much to drown this sorrow?

works.title: 下江陵
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【下江陵】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 朝辞白帝彩云间。千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住。轻舟巳过万重山。
works.appr: 《下江陵》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「朝辞白帝彩云间。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《下江陵》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

baihua_lines: 清晨辞别彩云缭绕之间的白帝城，
千里之遥的江陵一天就能到达。
两岸猿猴的啼叫声还在耳边不停回响，
轻快的小船已经驶过了万重青山。

en_lines: At dawn I bade farewell to Baidi City amid the colored clouds,
A thousand li to Jiangling — I shall arrive within a day.
The gibbons' cries still echo endlessly on either shore,
My light skiff has already passed ten thousand green mountains.

works.title: 下终南山过斛斯山人宿置酒
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【下终南山过斛斯山人宿置酒】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 暮從碧山下，山月隨人歸。却顧所來徑，蒼蒼橫翠微。相攜及田家，童稚開荆扉。綠竹入幽徑，青蘿拂行衣。歡言得所憩，美酒聊共揮。長歌吟松風，曲盡河星稀。我醉君復樂，陶然共忘機。

baihua_lines: 傍晚时分从碧绿的终南山上下来，
山月一路跟随着我归去。
回头望望刚才走过的山路，
苍苍茫茫的一片青翠横亘在山间。
与山人携手来到他的田家，
小孩子出来打开了柴门。
翠绿的竹子延伸进幽静的小路，
青青的女萝枝叶轻拂着行路的衣裳。
欢笑着交谈，得到了舒适的歇息，
我们频频举杯共饮美酒。
放声长歌，吟唱着松风的曲调，
曲罢之时银河上的星星已经稀疏。
我喝醉了，您也十分快乐，
我们欣然沉醉，一同忘却了世俗的心机。
works.baihua: 暮从碧山下，山月随人归。却顾所来径，苍苍横翠微。相携及田家，童稚开荆扉。绿竹入幽径，青萝拂行衣。欢言得所憩，美酒聊共挥。长歌吟松风，曲尽河星稀。我醉君复乐，陶然共忘机。
en_lines: At dusk I came down from the green slopes of Zhongnan Mountain,
The mountain moon accompanied me all the way back.
I turned my head to look upon the path I'd travelled,
Where endless verdant green stretched hazy across the hillside.
Hand in hand we walked to the mountain man's farm,
His little child pulled open the rough bramble gate.
Green bamboo lined the pathway, quiet and secluded,
Green vines brushed softly against our travelling clothes.
We talked and laughed in joy, finding welcome rest,
And freely passed the wine cup back and forth between us.
We sang loud songs to the tune of winds through pines,
When our songs ended, stars in the Milky Way had grown thin.
I was drunk and you were happy, too, my friend,
In simple joy together we forgot the world's sly schemes.

works.title: 关山月
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。；【关山月】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 明月出天山，蒼茫雲海間。長風幾萬里，吹度玉門關。漢下白登道，胡窺青海灣。由來征戰地，不見有人還。[戍]客望邊色，思歸多苦顏。高樓當此夜，歎息未應閑。

baihua_lines: 出没在苍茫的云海之间。
浩浩长风掠过几万里大地，
吹过了玉门关这个遥远的关隘。
当年汉军出兵攻打白登山道，
如今胡人仍然窥伺着青海湾一带。
这里自古以来就是征战之地，
出征的战士很少有人能活着回来。
戍边的将士们凝望着边城的方向，
思念家乡，个个脸上都满是愁苦。
今夜家中高楼上的妻子们，
应该也在叹息声声，不能停歇吧。
works.baihua: 明月出天山，苍茫云海间。长风几万里，吹度玉门关。汉下白登道，胡窥青海湾。由来征战地，不见有人还。[戍]客望边色，思归多苦颜。高楼当此夜，叹息未应闲。
en_lines: The bright moon rises over the Tianshan Mountains,
Amidst an endless sea of boundless, rolling clouds.
A mighty wind blows for tens of thousands of miles,
Sweeping across the far Jade Gate Pass of the frontier.
Han armies of old marched down the Baideng road,
And Tartar foes still eye the shores of Qinghai Bay.
Since ancient times this has been a land of battle,
And few who go to war have ever come back home.
Garrison soldiers gaze toward the borderlands,
Thinking of home, their faces lined with bitter grief.
In their high chambers this same night, their wives
Must also be sighing, sighing, and finding no rest.

works.title: 听蜀僧濬弹琴
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。；【听蜀僧濬弹琴】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 蜀僧抱綠綺，西下峨眉峰。爲我一揮手，如聽萬壑松。客心洗流水，餘響入霜鐘。不覺碧山暮，秋雲暗幾重。

【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

baihua_lines: 四川的僧人怀抱着名琴绿绮，
从西边的峨眉峰上下山而来。
他为我挥手弹奏了一曲，
听着就像万壑之中的松涛之声。
我的心灵像被流水洗涤过一样清畅，
琴声余音和着霜钟的声音一同回响。
不知不觉间碧山已笼罩在暮色之中，
秋空之上阴云重重，暗了几层天色。
works.baihua: 蜀僧抱绿绮，西下峨眉峰。为我一挥手，如听万壑松。客心洗流水，余响入霜钟。不觉碧山暮，秋云暗几重。
en_lines: A monk from Shu carried the famous Lyuqi zither,
Descending from the western slopes of Emei Peak.
For my sake he swept his hand across the strings,
And I seemed to hear pine winds in ten thousand valleys.
My traveller's heart was cleansed as if by flowing water,
The lingering notes mingled with the frosty temple bell.
Before I knew it, dusk had fallen on the green hills,
And autumn clouds had darkened fold on fold across the sky.

works.title: 夜宿山寺
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【夜宿山寺】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 危楼高百尺，手可摘星辰。不敢高声语，恐惊天上人。

Standing here I could reach up and pluck the very stars.
I dare not speak a word in a loud voice,
For fear of startling the immortals in heaven above.

baihua_lines: 银色的铜壶箭在寒漏中闪着寒光，
金色的油灯凝结着夜晚的光。
彩鸾在空中徒劳地独自飞舞，
离别的燕子不会相伴双双飞翔。
把一腔离恨寄托在一尺素绢之上，
将一对玉珰作为信物寄给远方的情人。
相会之前月亮还挂在天上，
分别之后才觉得黑夜如此漫长。
往事都经过了春天的风物，
未来的约定只能托书信来传达。
永远让那绣着粲花的枕头空着，
兰香馥郁的闺房也久久不关门。
睡醒时仿佛看到动静就猜是那人影来了，
疑心是情人到来，胡乱地辨认香气。
鹤应该会因白露降下而警觉鸣叫，
蜜蜂也为了采花而终日忙碌。
古时有楚王梦遇巫山神女的阳台梦，
如今多的是下蔡地方的美人歌姬。
为何要像冰雪一样淡薄呢？
日渐消瘦滞留在这不是故乡的地方。
works.baihua: 银箭耿寒漏，金釭凝夜光。彩鸾空自舞，别燕不相将。寄恨一尺素，含情双玉珰。会前犹月在，去后始宵长。往事经春物，前期托报章。永令虚粲枕，长不掩兰房。觉动迎猜影，疑来浪认香。鹤应闻露警，蜂亦为花忙。古有阳台梦，今多下蔡倡。何为薄冰雪，消瘦滞非乡。
en_lines: The silver arrow glows cold within the water clock,
The golden lamp holds fast the radiance of the night.
The colored phoenix dances vainly all alone,
Swallows that have parted do not fly in pairs again.
I send my regret on a foot of plain white silk,
And enclose a pair of jade earrings with my love.
Before we met, the moon still lingered in the sky,
After you left I first learned how long the nights could be.
Past events all passed with spring's fair things away,
Future hopes are trusted only to letters sent.
Ever the flower-embroidered pillow shall lie empty,
The orchid-scented chamber door remains long unlatched.
Waking to movement, I guess your shadow at last is here,
Imagining you come, I vainly sniff the air for your scent.
The crane must cry its warning when the white dew falls,
The bee too keeps busy gathering honey from the flowers.
Of old there was the dream of Yangtai where the king met the nymph,
And now the world is full of singing girls from Xiacai.
Why then be cold and thin as ice and winter snow?
Growing daily thinner, lingering in a land not home.

works.author: 李白

我登上船头仰望着秋夜的明月，
徒然怀念起东晋的谢尚将军。
我也能像袁宏那样高声吟咏诗篇，
可是像谢将军那样的知音却再也听不到了。
明天我就要挂起船帆乘船离去，
只有枫叶纷纷飘落，漫天飞舞。

en_lines: Night on the Western River at Niuzhu,
The blue sky is free of even a wisp of cloud.
I board the boat and gaze at the autumn moon,
Remembering vainly General Xie of Eastern Jin.
I too can chant my verses loud and clear,
But such a listener as he can be found no more.
Tomorrow I shall hoist my sail and leave this place,
While maple leaves fall fluttering, in countless numbers.

works.author: 李白
works.note: 【子夜吴歌·秋歌】唐代李白所作的诗。

千家万户都传来捣衣的声音。
秋风不停地吹，吹不尽的是，
妇人心中对玉门关外征人的思念之情。
什么时候才能平定胡人的侵扰，
丈夫就可以结束远征，回到家中。

en_lines: A single sheet of moonlight lies over Chang'an city,
From ten thousand households comes the sound of cloth being beaten.
The autumn wind blows on and on, yet cannot blow away
The tender thoughts that turn toward Yumen Pass and those beyond.
When at last shall the barbarian foe be fully subdued,
That husbands may return from far campaigns, and come back home?

works.author: 李白
body: 弃我去者昨日之日不可留，
乱我心者今日之日多烦忧。
works.note: 【宣州谢朓楼饯别校书叔云】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 棄我去者昨日之日不可留，亂我心者今日之日多煩憂。長風萬里送秋雁，對此可以酣高樓。蓬萊文章建安骨，中間小謝又清發。俱懷逸興壯思飛，欲上青天覽日月。抽刀斷水水更流，舉杯銷愁愁更愁。人生在世不稱意，明朝散髮弄扁舟。

baihua_lines: 弃我而去的昨天的时光，已经无法挽留，
乱我心绪的今天的时光，又平添了许多烦忧。
万里长风吹送着秋空的大雁南飞，
面对此景正可以在高楼上酣饮一场。
叔父的文章有建安文学那样的风骨，
而我的诗风也像谢朓那样清新秀发。
我们都满怀超逸的兴致，神思飞动，
想要飞上青天揽取天上的日月。
抽出宝刀砍断流水，水却流得更急，
举起酒杯想要消愁，愁绪却更加深重。
人生活在世间如果总是不能称心如意，
明天就披散头发乘一叶小舟，归隐江湖去吧。
works.baihua: 弃我去者昨日之日不可留，乱我心者今日之日多烦忧。长风万里送秋雁，对此可以酣高楼。蓬莱文章建安骨，中间小谢又清发。俱怀逸兴壮思飞，欲上青天览日月。抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁。人生在世不称意，明朝散发弄扁舟。
en_lines: The days of yesterday that left me — they cannot be stayed,
The days of today that trouble my heart heap fresh care and woe.
The long wind drives wild geese across ten thousand miles of autumn,
Facing this scene, let us drink deep within the high tower.
Your writings, uncle, have the bone and spirit of Jian'an,
While my own verses, like Xiao Xie's, are fresh and bright.
We both are filled with soaring thoughts that leap and fly,
Longing to rise to the blue sky and seize the sun and moon.
I draw a blade to cut the flowing water — yet it flows the faster,
I raise my cup to drown my grief — yet grief grows deeper still.
If in this life our wishes never can be gratified,
Tomorrow I shall let down my hair and drift away in a small boat.

works.title: 将进酒
works.author: 李白
body: 君不见黄河之水天上来，
君不见高堂明镜悲白发，
works.note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【将进酒】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 君不見黃河之水天上來，奔流到海不復迴。君不見高堂明鏡悲白髮，朝如青絲暮成雪。人生得意須盡歡，莫使金樽空對月。天生我材必有用，千金散盡還復來。烹羊宰牛且爲樂，會須一飲三百盃。岑夫子，丹丘生，將進酒，君莫停。與君歌一曲，請君爲我側耳聽。鐘鼓饌玉不足貴，但願長醉不願醒。古來聖賢皆寂寞，惟有飲者留其名。陳王昔時宴平樂，斗酒十千恣讙謔。主人何爲言少錢，徑須沽取對君酌。五花馬，千金裘，呼兒將出換美酒，與爾同銷萬古愁。

baihua_lines: 你难道没看见，黄河之水从天上奔流而来，
波涛滚滚奔向大海，再也不会回来。
你难道没看见，在高堂上对着明镜悲叹白发苍苍，
早晨还像青丝一般黑，傍晚就白得像雪一样。
人生在世，得意的时候就应当尽情欢乐，
不要让金杯空对着皎洁的明月。
上天生下我这样的人才必定有它的用处，
千金花光之后还会再重新聚来。
烹羊宰牛姑且尽情享乐一番，
要喝就应当一口气喝上三百杯。
请你们为我侧耳仔细听。
钟鸣鼎食那样的富贵生活根本不值得珍贵，
只愿长醉不醒，不愿意清醒过来。
自古以来的圣贤都寂寞无闻，
只有善饮的人才能留下美名。
陈王曹植从前在平乐观设宴，
一斗酒值十千钱，也尽情地欢饮戏谑。
主人怎么能说钱不够了呢？
径直去买酒来，让我们一起痛饮。
都叫孩子拿出去换美酒来吧，
和你们一同消解这万古长愁！
works.baihua: 君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回。君不见高堂明镜悲白发，朝如青丝暮成雪。人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月。天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来。烹羊宰牛且为乐，会须一饮三百杯。岑夫子，丹丘生，将进酒，君莫停。与君歌一曲，请君为我侧耳听。钟鼓馔玉不足贵，但愿长醉不愿醒。古来圣贤皆寂寞，惟有饮者留其名。陈王昔时宴平乐，斗酒十千恣讙谑。主人何为言少钱，径须沽取对君酌。五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁。
en_lines: Do you not see the Yellow River's waters coming down from heaven,
Rushing to the sea, their waves never to return again?
Do you not see in the high hall, before the bright mirror, men grieve white hair?
At dawn it was like black silk, by evening it is white as snow.
When life goes well, then taste all the joy you can,
And never let your golden cup stand empty to the moon.
Heaven made my talent for a purpose — it shall not be in vain,
A thousand gold coins spent, they will return to me again.
Boil the sheep, butcher the ox, and let us make merry for a while,
We must drink three hundred cups in one great draught today.
I sing of this scene yet still.
Life now here there still yet still.
Bring in the wine,
And let no cup cease for a moment.
I shall sing a song for you both,
I pray you lend me your ears and listen well.
Bells and tripods, rare feasts — these things are not worth prizing,
I only wish long drunkenness, never to wake to sobriety.
Since ancient times all sages and worthies have been forgotten in silence,
Only great drinkers have left their names behind them.
Of old, Prince of Chen held feasts at Pingleguan,
With wine at ten thousand coins a cask, he laughed and jested freely.
Why does the host say he has not enough of money?
Go buy more wine at once, and pour it out for us.
That dappled horse, the five-flowered steed,
And the thousand-gold fox-fur robe,
Call the boy out to take them and exchange for fine wine,
And together with you I shall drown the sorrows of ten thousand ages!

works.author: 李白
works.note: 【峨眉山月歌】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 峨眉山月半轮秋。影入平羌江水流。夜发青溪向三峡。思君不见下渝州。

en_body: Above Mount Emei, the autumn moon hangs in half its disk.
Its shadow falls upon the Pingqiang, drifting with the current.
At night I leave Qingxi, setting out toward the Three Gorges.
Longing for you yet unable to meet, I drift onward to Yuzhou.

works.title: 庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 我本楚狂人，鳳歌笑孔丘。手持綠玉杖，朝別黃鶴樓。五嶽尋仙不辭遠，一生好入名山遊。廬山秀出南斗傍，屏風九疊雲錦張，影落明湖青黛光。金闕前開二峰長，銀河倒挂三石梁。香爐瀑布遙相望，迴厓沓嶂凌蒼蒼。翠影紅霞映朝日，鳥飛不到吳天長。登高壯觀天地間，大江茫茫去不還。黃雲萬里動風色，白波九道流雪山。好爲廬山謠，興因廬山發。閑窺石鏡清我心，謝公行處蒼苔沒。早服還丹無世情，琴心三疊道初成。遙見仙人綵雲裏，手把芙蓉朝玉京。先期汗漫九垓上，願接盧敖遊太清。

en_body: I am by nature the madman of Chu,
Singing the Phoenix Song to mock Confucius himself.
In my hand I hold a staff of green jade,
At dawn I bid farewell to the Yellow Crane Tower.
To seek immortals on the Five Peaks I spare no distance,

高唱凤歌嘲笑孔丘那种汲汲于仕途的人。
手里拿着绿玉装饰的手杖，
到五岳寻访仙人从来不嫌路途遥远，
我这一生就喜爱进入名山游览。
庐山挺拔秀丽，高耸在南斗星旁，
九叠屏风般的山峰像云锦般铺展开来，
山影倒映在明净的湖面上，泛着青黑色的光。
金阙岩前两座山峰遥遥相对、绵延伸展，
三石梁的瀑布像银河倒挂在山间。
香炉峰的瀑布与它遥遥相望，
曲折的悬崖和层叠的山峰直插苍茫青天。
翠绿山影与灿烂红霞映照着朝阳，
连飞鸟都到不了的地方，吴地的天空分外辽远。
登高望远，壮观的景象尽在天地之间，
大江浩浩荡荡向东流去，一去不回。
黄云万里，天色随风变幻，
长江九道支流白浪翻滚，像流动的雪山。
我喜爱为庐山写下歌谣，
诗兴因庐山的壮美而勃发。

我早已服食仙丹，了却世俗的情欲，
琴心三叠修炼完成，道业刚刚有所成就。
远远望见仙人们站在彩云之间，
手捧着莲花飞向玉京朝拜天帝。
我早已和汗漫相约在九天之上，
希望能像卢敖那样，接你同游太清仙境。

works.title: 怨情
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【怨情】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 新人如花雖可寵，故人似玉由來重。花性飄揚不自持，玉心皎潔終不移。故人昔新今尚故，還見新人有故時。請看陳后黃金屋，寂寂珠簾生網絲。

en_body: The new love is like a flower, charming to dote upon,
Yet the old friend is like fine jade, valued through the ages.
The flower's nature is drifting, unable to hold itself steady,
But the heart of jade, pure and bright, never changes.
The old friend was once new, and now is old,
You too shall see this new love grow old in time.
Look, I pray you, at the Golden House where Empress Chen once dwelt,
Now silent and desolate, cobwebs strung across its pearl curtains.

In Qin the mulberry branches already hang heavy with leaves.

Spring wind, you and I have never known each other,
Why then do you blow through my silken bedcurtains?

works.author: 李白
works.note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。；【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。

en_body: Amid the flowers, a single pot of wine,
I pour alone, with no one close at hand.
Raising my cup, I beckon the bright moon to join me,
And with my shadow in the moonlight, we make three.
The moon, alas, knows nothing of drinking,
And my shadow only follows my body in vain.
For now I'll keep company with moon and shadow,
Seizing joy before the springtime slips away.
I sing, and the moon seems to linger and listen,
I dance, and my shadow tangles and sways with me.
While sober still, we share our merriment together,
Once drunk, each goes our separate way.
Let us seal this bond of passionless friendship,
Meeting again on the far banks of the Silver River.

举起酒杯邀请天上的明月共饮，
再加上月光下我的影子，就成了三个人。
月亮本来不懂得饮酒的乐趣，
影子也只是徒然地跟随着我的身子。
我暂且伴着明月和清影，
要趁着美好的春光及时行乐。

清醒的时候我们一起欢乐，
醉了以后便各自分散离去。
我愿与他们结下永远忘情的交谊，
相约在遥远的银河边再次相见。

works.background: 《望天门山》为唐代李白所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者李白在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Tianmen Mountain split apart by the Chu River, opening a passage,
Its emerald waters flow east, then turn and swirl back north.
Green mountains face each other across the river, rising tall on either bank,
A single lonely sail comes gliding from where the sun rises.
baihua_lines: 天门山被长江从中间劈开，碧绿的江水向东流到这里，
被山崖阻挡，激起回旋的波涛。
两岸的青山隔着江水相对耸立，
一叶孤帆从太阳升起的地方悠悠驶来。
works.baihua: 天门中断楚江开。碧水东流向北回。两岸青山相对出。孤帆一片日边来。

works.title: 望庐山瀑布
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【望庐山瀑布】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川。飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。

works.title: 梦游天姥吟留别
works.author: 李白
body: 熊咆龙吟殷岩泉，栗深林兮惊层巅。
云青青兮欲雨，水澹澹兮生烟。
霓为衣兮风为马，云之君兮纷纷而来下。
虎鼓瑟兮鸾回车，仙之人兮列如麻。
works.note: 【兮】楚辞及古诗常见语气词，相当于"啊"，用于舒缓节奏、增强咏叹意味。；【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。
works.tr: 海客談瀛洲，煙濤微茫信難求。越人語天姥，雲霓明滅或可覩。天姥連天向天橫，勢拔五嶽掩赤城。天台四萬八千丈，對此欲倒東南傾。我欲因之夢吳越，一夜飛度鏡湖月。湖月照我影，送我至剡溪。謝公宿處今尚在，淥水蕩漾清猨啼。脚著謝公屐，身登青雲梯。半壁見海日，空中聞天雞。千巖萬轉路不定，迷花倚石忽已暝。熊咆龍吟殷巖泉，慄深林啊，驚層巔。雲青青啊，欲雨，水澹澹啊，生煙。列缺霹靂，丘巒崩摧。洞天石扇，訇然中開。青冥浩蕩不見底，日月照耀金銀臺。霓爲衣啊，風爲馬，雲之君啊，紛紛而來下。虎鼓瑟啊，鸞迴車，仙之人啊，列如麻。忽魂悸以魄動，怳驚起而長嗟。惟覺時之枕席，失向來之煙霞。世間行樂亦如此，古來萬事東流水。別君去時何時還，且放白鹿青崖間，須行即騎訪名山。安能摧眉折腰事權貴？使我不得開心顏。

en_body: Seafarers speak of Yingzhou, the immortal isle,
Lost in mist and waves, truly hard to find.
But when the people of Yue speak of Tianmu Mountain,
Through shifting clouds and light it may sometimes be glimpsed.
Tianmu rises to the sky, linking heaven itself, stretching across the horizon,
Its peaks surmount the Five Holy Mountains, overshadowing Chicheng.
Tiantai Mountain stands forty-eight thousand zhang tall,
Yet beside Tianmu it seems to tilt and bow toward the southeast.
And so I longed to journey in dream to the lands of Wu and Yue,
In one night flying across Mirror Lake under the bright moon.
The moonlight on Mirror Lake cast my shadow before me,
And escorted me all the way to Shan Creek.
Where Xie Lingyun once dwelled can still be found today,
Clear waters rippling, monkeys crying with shrill, clear calls.
On my feet I wore the wooden clogs Xie Lingyun himself made,
Climbing in person the mountain paths that scale the very clouds.
Halfway up the slope, I saw the sun rising from the sea,
And high in the air I heard the Heavenly Cock crow the dawn.
Countless twisted rocks, winding paths that turned and twisted,
Enchanted by flowers, resting against stones, I did not notice night falling.
Bears roared, dragons howled, resounding through rock and stream, making deep forests tremble and layered peaks shake with dread.
The clouds turned black and heavy, threatening rain, the waters stirred and rose, throwing up a mist.
Lightning flashed,
Thunder roared, as if mountain peaks themselves were crumbling and collapsing.
The stone gates of the immortal palace,
With a great roar, swung open from within.
Inside, an azure sky stretched boundless, endless,
Sun and moon shining upon palaces of gold and silver.
Clad in rainbows, riding upon the wind, the immortals of the clouds descended, one after another.
Tigers played upon zithers, phoenixes drew their chariots, Immortals crowded by, dense as hemp in a field.
Suddenly my soul shook,
I woke with a start, and sighed a long, deep sigh.
Awake to find only my pillow and mat beside me,
The mist and clouds of my dream had all vanished away.
All the joys of the human world are just like this,
Since ancient times, all things flow east like water, never returning.
After I part from you, when shall I come back again?
For now I shall pasture my white deer among the green cliffs,
And when I must go, ride it forth to visit famous mountains.
How could I bow my head and serve the powerful and highborn,
Letting myself be robbed of a happy, free smile!

baihua_lines: 航海的人谈起海外的瀛洲仙山，
烟波渺茫，实在难以寻找。
在云霞明灭间有时还能看见。
天姥山高耸入云，连接着天际，横亘在天外，
山势高峻超过五岳，遮掩过赤城山。
天台山高达四万八千丈，
对着天姥山也好像要向东南倾斜拜倒。
我因此想要梦到吴越一带，
一夜之间就飞渡过了明月映照下的镜湖。
镜湖上的月光照着我的影子，
谢灵运当年住过的地方至今还在，
清澈的湖水荡漾，猿猴的啼声清厉。
我脚上穿着谢灵运当年特制的木屐，
亲身攀登着那直上云霄的山路。
半山腰就看见了从海上升起的太阳，
半空中传来了天鸡报晓的啼叫。
无数山岩重叠，道路曲折盘旋，方向不定，
我正迷恋着花，依倚着石，不觉天色已经晚了。
熊在咆哮，龙在长吟，震响在岩石和泉水之间，使深林战栗，使层层山峰震惊。
云层黑沉沉的，像是要下雨，水波动荡生起了烟雾。
雷声轰鸣，山峰好像要被崩塌似的。
洞中蔚蓝的天空广阔无际，看不到尽头，
日月照耀着金银铸成的宫阙。
用彩虹做衣裳，把长风当作马，云中的神仙们纷纷下来。
老虎弹奏着琴瑟，鸾鸟驾着车，仙人们成群结队，密密麻麻像麻一样多。
醒来时只有身边的枕席，
刚才梦中所见的烟雾云霞全都消失了。
人世间的欢乐也不过如此，
自古以来万事都像东流的水一样一去不复返。
与君分别之后，什么时候才能回来？
暂且把白鹿放牧在青崖间，
等到要走的时候就骑它去访问名山。
我怎么能够低头弯腰去侍奉那些权贵，
让我自己不能有舒心畅意的笑颜！
works.baihua: 海客谈瀛洲，烟涛微茫信难求。越人语天姥，云霓明灭或可覩。天姥连天向天横，势拔五岳掩赤城。天台四万八千丈，对此欲倒东南倾。我欲因之梦吴越，一夜飞度镜湖月。湖月照我影，送我至剡溪。谢公宿处今尚在，渌水荡漾清猨啼。脚著谢公屐，身登青云梯。半壁见海日，空中闻天鸡。千岩万转路不定，迷花倚石忽已暝。熊咆龙吟殷岩泉，栗深林啊，惊层巅。云青青啊，欲雨，水澹澹啊，生烟。列缺霹雳，丘峦崩摧。洞天石扇，訇然中开。青冥浩荡不见底，日月照耀金银台。霓为衣啊，风为马，云之君啊，纷纷而来下。虎鼓瑟啊，鸾回车，仙之人啊，列如麻。忽魂悸以魄动，怳惊起而长嗟。惟觉时之枕席，失向来之烟霞。世间行乐亦如此，古来万事东流水。别君去时何时还，且放白鹿青崖间，须行即骑访名山。安能摧眉折腰事权贵？使我不得开心颜。
en_lines: Seafarers speak of Yingzhou, the immortal isle,
Lost in mist and waves, truly hard to find.
But when the people of Yue speak of Tianmu Mountain,
Through shifting clouds and light it may sometimes be glimpsed.
Tianmu rises to the sky, linking heaven itself, stretching across the horizon,
Its peaks surmount the Five Holy Mountains, overshadowing Chicheng.
Tiantai Mountain stands forty-eight thousand zhang tall,
Yet beside Tianmu it seems to tilt and bow toward the southeast.
And so I longed to journey in dream to the lands of Wu and Yue,
In one night flying across Mirror Lake under the bright moon.
The moonlight on Mirror Lake cast my shadow before me,
And escorted me all the way to Shan Creek.
Where Xie Lingyun once dwelled can still be found today,
Clear waters rippling, monkeys crying with shrill, clear calls.
On my feet I wore the wooden clogs Xie Lingyun himself made,
Climbing in person the mountain paths that scale the very clouds.
Halfway up the slope, I saw the sun rising from the sea,
And high in the air I heard the Heavenly Cock crow the dawn.
Countless twisted rocks, winding paths that turned and twisted,
Enchanted by flowers, resting against stones, I did not notice night falling.
Bears roared, dragons howled, resounding through rock and stream, making deep forests tremble and layered peaks shake with dread.
The clouds turned black and heavy, threatening rain, the waters stirred and rose, throwing up a mist.
I sing of this scene yet still.
Thunder roared, as if mountain peaks themselves were crumbling and collapsing.
The stone gates of the immortal palace,
With a great roar, swung open from within.
Inside, an azure sky stretched boundless, endless,
Sun and moon shining upon palaces of gold and silver.
Clad in rainbows, riding upon the wind, the immortals of the clouds descended, one after another.
Tigers played upon zithers, phoenixes drew their chariots, Immortals crowded by, dense as hemp in a field.
Suddenly my soul shook,
I woke with a start, and sighed a long, deep sigh.
Awake to find only my pillow and mat beside me,
The mist and clouds of my dream had all vanished away.
All the joys of the human world are just like this,
Since ancient times, all things flow east like water, never returning.
After I part from you, when shall I come back again?
For now I shall pasture my white deer among the green cliffs,
And when I must go, ride it forth to visit famous mountains.
How could I bow my head and serve the powerful and highborn,
Letting myself be robbed of a happy, free smile!

works.title: 清平调·其一
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【春风】春日和风，常喻恩泽、喜悦或美好时光。；【清平调·其一】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓。若非群玉山头见，会向瑶台月下逢。
works.appr: 《清平调·其一》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「云想衣裳花想容，」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《清平调·其一》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

【承】第二句承接延展，铺陈画面与情境。

works.img:
【月】月亮意象，常寄托思乡、怀人、孤寂之意，亦象征高洁、永恒。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【云】白云意象，象征隐逸、自在、游子漂泊。

【风】风意象，春风主喜乐，秋风主悲愁，东风送春，西风送秋。

【花】花意象，喻美好青春，落花则有伤春、惜逝之意。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
works.bg: 《清平调·其一》为唐代李白所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者李白在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
works.theme: 《清平调·其一》主旨在于描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。；登临怀古，借古抒怀，寄寓历史兴亡之感。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代李白的代表性作品之一。

Spring breeze brushes the railings, dew making the flowers glow rich and fair.
If I had not seen her at the peak of Qunyu Mountain,
I must have met her beneath the moon at Yao Terrace.

Coming to journey through the ancient land of Chu.
The mountains faded away as the level plains unfolded,
The great river flowed onward through the endless wilderness.

Clouds formed and wove into mirages of cities in the sky.
Still I cherish the waters that come from my homeland,
Carrying my boat ten thousand li, seeing me off on my long journey.

山随着低平的原野出现，逐渐消失，
江水在一望无际的旷野中奔流。

works.appreciation: 《玉阶怨》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「玉阶生白露。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，情景交融，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《玉阶怨》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_translation: White dew has formed upon the marble steps,
Standing long into the night, dew soaks through her silk stockings.
Returning to her chamber, she lets down the crystal curtain,
And gazes through it at the delicate, clear autumn moon.
baihua_lines: 玉砌的台阶上已经生出了白露，
深夜久久伫立，露水浸湿了罗袜。
回到房中放下那水晶帘子，
隔着帘子凝望着玲珑的秋月。

works.title: 登金陵凤凰台
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【登金陵凤凰台】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 鳳凰臺上鳳凰遊，鳳去臺空江自流。吳宮花草埋幽徑，晉代衣冠成古丘。三山半落青天外，二水中分白鷺洲。總爲浮雲能蔽日，長安不見使人愁。

en_body: Once the phoenix came to roam upon Phoenix Terrace,
The phoenix has flown, the terrace is empty, only the river still flows on alone.
Flowers and grasses of the Wu palace bury the quiet paths,
The great lords of Jin times have long become mounds in ancient tombs.
The Three Mountains appear half beyond the blue sky,
Egret Islet splits the Yangtze into two streams.
The floating clouds in the sky always cover the sun,
And not seeing Chang'an fills my heart with sorrow.

baihua_lines: 凤凰台上曾经有凤凰来游憩，
凤凰飞去之后，台空了，只有江水依然独自奔流。
吴国宫殿里的花花草草，埋没在幽静的小径里，
东晋时代的那些达官贵人，早已成了古墓中的荒丘。
三山的半截山峰，仿佛落在青天外面，
白鹭洲把长江分成两条水道。
天上的浮云总是遮蔽着太阳，
看不见长安，使我心中满怀忧愁。

works.title: 蜀道难
works.author: 李白
body: 嗟尔远道之人胡为乎来哉！
works.note: 【蜀道难】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 噫吁戲！危乎高啊！蜀道之難難於上青天！蠶叢及魚鳧，開國何茫然。爾來四萬八千歲，不與秦塞通人煙。西當太白有鳥道，可以橫絕峨眉巔。地崩山摧壯士死，然後天梯石棧相鉤連。上有六龍回日之高標，下有衝波逆折之回川。黃鶴之飛尚不得過，猨猱欲度愁攀援。青泥何盤盤，百步九折縈巖巒。捫參歷井仰脅息，以手撫膺坐長歎。問君西遊何時還？畏途巉巖不可攀。但見悲鳥號古木，雄飛雌從繞林間。又聞子規啼夜月，愁空山，蜀道之難難於上青天，使人聽此凋朱顏。連峯去天不盈尺，枯松倒挂倚絕壁。飛湍瀑流爭喧豗，砅厓轉石萬壑雷。其險也如此，嗟爾遠道之人胡爲乎來啊！劒閣崢嶸而崔嵬，一夫當關，萬夫莫開。所守或匪親，化爲狼與豺。朝避猛虎，夕避長蛇。磨牙吮血，殺人如麻。錦城雖云樂，不如早還家。蜀道之難難於上青天，側身西望長咨嗟。

en_body: Alas-a-me!
How sheer, how perilously high!
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
Cancong and Yufu, ancient kings of Shu,
How lost in the mists of time was their founding of the kingdom!
Forty-eight thousand years have passed since those days,
Yet Qin and Shu remained cut off by the mountains, no intercourse between them.
On the west, Taibai Mountain has only a path birds can traverse,
A track by which one might cross the very summit of Emei.
The earth split, the mountain crumbled, five heroes of Shu perished,
Only then were sky-ladders and plank roads built to connect the two lands.
Above stands the highest peak where even the sun god's chariot must turn back,
Below, the rushing, churning, winding torrent twists and eddies.
Even the yellow crane, that highest-flying bird, cannot cross it,
Even agile gibbons despair of climbing it, for all their skill.
How winding and twisting is the path over Qingni Ridge,
Every hundred paces it loops nine times around the mountain slopes.
Travelers can reach the stars Shen and Jing, holding their breath as they gaze upward,
Clutching their chests in terror, sighing long and deep in vain.
Dear friend, I ask you: when will you return from this westward journey into Shu?
This fearsome road is too dangerous, too sheer and steep to climb.
I see only mournful birds crying in ancient trees,
Male and female flying together through the desolate woods.
And I hear the cuckoo crying in the moonlit night,
Its sorrow ringing through the empty mountains,
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
Hearing these words makes one's face turn pale in an instant.
Continuous peaks rise less than a foot from heaven itself,
Withered pines hang upside down, leaning against the sheer precipices.
Flying rapids and cascades vie in roaring clamor,
Waters dashing against boulders, pounding cliffs, thundering through thousands of valleys.
The road to Shu is this dangerous,
Ah me! O traveler come from afar, why did you ever come here?
Jian'ge Pass is lofty and precipitous,
One man guards the gate,
And ten thousand cannot force it.
If the general defending it is not a trusted kinsman,
He will turn into a wolf or jackal preying on passersby.
In the morning you must avoid fierce tigers,
In the evening you must guard against long serpents.
They sharpen their fangs, suck blood and devour flesh,
The men they kill number as many as hemp stalks in a field.
Though Jincheng is said to be a place of pleasure,
It is better to hurry home early.
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
I turn my face westward and cannot help but heave a long, deep sigh!

Even the yellow crane, that highest-flying bird, cannot cross it,
Even agile gibbons despair of climbing it, for all their skill.
How winding and twisting is the path over Qingni Ridge,
Every hundred paces it loops nine times around the mountain slopes.
Travelers can reach the stars Shen and Jing, holding their breath as they gaze upward,
Clutching their chests in terror, sighing long and deep in vain.
Dear friend, I ask you: when will you return from this westward journey into Shu?
This fearsome road is too dangerous, too sheer and steep to climb.
I see only mournful birds crying in ancient trees,
Male and female flying together through the desolate woods.
And I hear the cuckoo crying in the moonlit night,
Its sorrow ringing through the empty mountains,
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
Hearing these words makes one's face turn pale in an instant.
Continuous peaks rise less than a foot from heaven itself,
Withered pines hang upside down, leaning against the sheer precipices.
Flying rapids and cascades vie in roaring clamor,
Waters dashing against boulders, pounding cliffs, thundering through thousands of valleys.
The road to Shu is this dangerous,
Ah me! O traveler come from afar, why did you ever come here?
Jian'ge Pass is lofty and precipitous,
One man guards the gate,
And ten thousand cannot force it.
If the general defending it is not a trusted kinsman,
He will turn into a wolf or jackal preying on passersby.
In the morning you must avoid fierce tigers,
In the evening you must guard against long serpents.
They sharpen their fangs, suck blood and devour flesh,
The men they kill number as many as hemp stalks in a field.
Though Jincheng is said to be a place of pleasure,
It is better to hurry home early.
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
I turn my face westward and cannot help but heave a long, deep sigh!
baihua_lines: 蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
蚕丛和鱼凫这两位古代蜀王，
他们开国的事迹是多么渺茫遥远啊！
从那时以来经历了四万八千岁，
秦蜀两地被秦岭阻隔，人们从不曾互相往来。
西边太白山只有飞鸟能过的小道，
从那小路走可以横渡峨眉山顶端。
山崩地裂，蜀国五位壮士被压死，
然后两地才有天梯栈道开始相通连。
上面有太阳神的车驾也要掉头的高峰，
下面有波涛滚滚、回旋曲折的激流。
善于高飞的黄鹤尚且无法飞过，
即使猿猱想要攀过也愁于无法攀援。
青泥岭的山路是多么曲折绕弯，
百步之内就要绕着山峦转九道弯。
行人可以摸到参星、触到井星，仰头屏息，
用手抚胸惊恐不已，徒然长吁短叹。
好朋友啊，请问你西游入蜀什么时候回来？
可怕的山道实在太艰险，陡峭高峻难以攀登。
只见悲鸟在古树上哀鸣啼叫，
雄雌相随飞翔在荒凉的树林之间。
又听见月夜里杜鹃声声啼叫，
蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
让人听了这话，顿时脸色都变了。
连绵的山峰离天不到一尺远，
枯老的松树倒挂着，斜倚在绝壁之上。
飞奔的激流和瀑布争相喧闹着，
流水撞击着巨石、冲击山崖，在千山万壑间发出雷鸣般的轰响。
唉呀呀，你这位远道而来的客人，为什么要到这里来呢？
把守关口的将领如果不是亲信，
它们磨尖牙齿，吮血食肉，
蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
我侧身向西望去，禁不住长长地叹息！

Yet Qin and Shu remained cut off by the mountains, no intercourse between them.
On the west, Taibai Mountain has only a path birds can traverse,
A track by which one might cross the very summit of Emei.

Below, the rushing, churning, winding torrent twists and eddies.

works.title: 行路难·其一
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。
works.tr: 金樽清酒斗十千，玉盘珍羞直万钱。停杯投箸不能食，拔剑四顾心茫然。欲渡黄河冰塞川，将登太行雪满山。闲来垂钓碧溪上，忽复乘舟梦日边。行路难，行路难，多歧路，今安在？长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海。
works.appr: 《行路难·其一》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共11句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《行路难·其一》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。
works.st:
【起·开篇】前2句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第3至5句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第6至8句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末3句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。

【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【河】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【云】白云意象，象征隐逸、自在、游子漂泊。

en_body: Clear wine in golden cups costs ten thousand cash a dou,
Precious delicacies on jade plates are worth ten thousand more.
Yet in my sorrow I lay down cup and chopsticks, unable to eat,
I draw my sword and gaze around me, my heart lost in confusion.
I wish to cross the Yellow River, but ice and snow block the stream,
I would climb Taihang Mountain, but blizzards have sealed the passes.
Once I fished like Jiang Taigong upon the green brook,
Or like Yi Yin who dreamed he sailed a boat past the sun.
The road through life is hard!
How hard it is!
So many branching paths before me,
Where am I now?
I believe a day will come when I ride the long wind, cleaving ten thousand waves,
Hoisting my cloud sail high to sail boldly across the vast sea!

baihua_lines: 金杯中的美酒一斗价值十千钱，
玉盘里珍贵的菜肴价值万钱。
胸中郁闷啊，我放下杯子和筷子吃不下饭，
拔出宝剑环顾四周，心里一片茫然。
想渡黄河，冰雪却堵塞了这条大川，
要登太行山，莽莽风雪早已封山。
像姜太公吕尚在碧溪上垂钓，
又像伊尹做梦，乘船经过日边。
相信总有一天，能乘长风破万里浪，
高高挂起云帆，在沧海中勇往直前！

works.title: 赠孟浩然
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【赠孟浩然】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 吾愛孟夫子，風流天下聞。紅顏棄軒冕，白首臥松雲。醉月頻中聖，迷花不事君。高山安可仰，徒此揖清芬。
works.appr: 《赠孟浩然》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《赠孟浩然》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

en_body: I deeply respect and love Master Meng,
Whose free and noble spirit is known throughout the world.
In youth you disdained official rank and honor, casting aside carriage and cap,
In white-haired old age you rest among pines and clouds, withdrawn to the hills.
Under the bright moon you often lie in drunken bliss,
Lost among mountains and streams, unwilling to serve the emperor.
How can one look up to such mountain-like loftiness?
I can only bow to you here, revering your fragrant virtue.

en_translation: I deeply respect and love Master Meng,
Whose free and noble spirit is known throughout the world.
In youth you disdained official rank and honor, casting aside carriage and cap,
In white-haired old age you rest among pines and clouds, withdrawn to the hills.
Under the bright moon you often lie in drunken bliss,
Lost among mountains and streams, unwilling to serve the emperor.

works.author: 李白
works.note: 【赠汪伦】唐代李白所作的诗。

When suddenly I heard the sound of stamping and singing coming from the shore.

works.author: 李白

White waters go winding around the eastern wall.

The setting sun hangs low, like the old friend's reluctant heart.
We wave our hands and take our leave from this place,
Our parting horses neigh long and mournfully, stirring infinite sorrow.

en_translation: My old friend bids me farewell west of Yellow Crane Tower,
In the misty willow-catkin month of March, when flowers are in full bloom, he sails down to Yangzhou.
The sail of his lone boat gradually vanishes into the blue-green horizon,
Leaving only the long Yangtze River flowing toward the distant edge of heaven.

只看见一线长江向邈远的天际奔流。

works.author: 李白

works.title: 长干行
works.author: 李白
works.note: 【长干行】唐代李白所作的诗。
works.tr: 憶昔深閨裏，煙塵不曾識。嫁與長干人，沙頭候風色。五月南風興，思君下巴陵。八月西風起，想君發[揚]子。去來悲如何，見少離別多。湘潭幾日到，妾夢越風波。昨夜狂風度，吹折江頭樹。淼淼暗無邊，行人在何處。北客真三公，朱衣滿江中。薄暮來投宿，數朝不肯東。好乘浮雲驄，佳期蘭渚東。鴛鴦綠浦上，翡翠錦屏中。自憐十五餘，顏色桃花紅。那作商人婦，愁水復愁風。

en_body: I remember when I lived deep in the inner chambers,
I had never known the dust and smoke of the world.
I married a man of Changgan,
Waiting by the sandbar for the wind to change.
In May the south wind rises,
Longing for you, I follow you down to Baling.
In August the west wind blows,
Thinking of you setting out from Yangzi Ford.
In all this coming and going, how great the sorrow,
Few the meetings, many the partings.
How many days to reach Xiangtan?
My dreaming soul crosses wind and waves to seek you.
Last night a fierce wind passed,
Breaking trees at the river's head.
The waters stretch vast and dark, without bound,
Where can the traveler be now?
Northern visitors are truly noble lords,
Men in crimson robes fill the river.
At dusk they come to seek lodging,
For many days they refuse to travel east.
Let us ride the fine dappled steeds like floating clouds,
The trysting place lies east of the Orchid Islet.
Mandarin ducks sport upon the green shore,
Kingfishers among the brocade screens.
Pity me, barely over fifteen years old,
My complexion still pink as peach blossoms.
How did I become a merchant's wife,
Worrying over dangerous waters, fearing fierce winds?

works.author: 李白

en_body: Endless longing,
In Chang'an.
The autumn cricket chirps by the golden well railing,
Thin frost lies chill, the bamboo mat grows cold.
A single lamp burns dim, my longing almost breaks me,
I roll up the curtain, gaze at the moon, and sigh in vain.
My beloved, fair as flowers, is separated by the clouds!
Above is the dark, infinite expanse of high heaven,
Below are the waves of clear green waters.
Heaven is high, the road is far, my soul flies in torment as I search,
Barred by mountains and passes, even dreams cannot cross.
Endless longing,
It breaks my very heart!

Long now here there still yet still.
The autumn cricket chirps by the golden well railing,

Long think of sun night yet still.
It breaks my very heart!

The King of Chu's tryst with the goddess at Wu Mountain was only heartbreak in vain.

en_body: After ten years of war and separation,
We meet unexpectedly, now grown to adulthood.
Asking your surname, I was startled at this first encounter,
But when you spoke your name I remembered your old face.
We spoke of all the vast changes that had passed since we parted,
Until our talk was done and the evening bell rang out.
Tomorrow you must take the road to Baling again,
And after this parting, autumn mountains will lie between us once more.

notes.explanation: 唐代李益所作的诗。

works.translation: 十年離亂後，長大一相逢。問姓驚初見，稱名憶舊容。別來滄海事，語罷暮天鐘。明日巴陵道，秋山又幾重。
works.appreciation: 《喜见外弟又言别》是唐代李益所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《喜见外弟又言别》历代传诵不衰，是李益诗歌风格的集中体现。

baihua_lines: 经过了十年的战乱流离之后，
我们长大成人，才意外相逢。

这一别，又隔着几重秋山。
